articles.title: SOMA: A Benchmark for Fine-Grained Egocentric Behavior and Body-Motion Understanding
articles.abstract: Perceiving human body motion is critical for multimodal systems that understand and assist people. Yet current evaluations of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) largely focus on objects, scenes, and coarse actions, leaving their ability to reason about the body itself poorly assessed. This is especially challenging from the egocentric perspective, in which the body is only partially visible and motion must be inferred from occluded and temporally distributed cues. We introduce SOMA, a benchmark for fine-grained body-motion understanding from egocentric video, comprising 1,632 human-verified questions across three capability axes: body configuration, motion dynamics, and temporal reasoning. We evaluate 37 leading closed-source, open-source, and specialized egocentric MLLMs, complemented by an extensive human evaluation. We find that humans also find this task difficult from video alone (68.5% accuracy), yet clearly outperform the strongest MLLM (Qwen3.6-27B), which reaches 50.0% zero-shot accuracy. Our error analysis shows that MLLMs often misread the wearer's own body, misjudge events in time, and are prone to biases such as favoring the right hand or under-counting repetitions. To narrow the gap to human performance and support further progress, we introduce a training dataset of aligned video, body motion, and language supervision, and a multimodal baseline that jointly learns from these modalities. By identifying common failure modes and missing capabilities in current MLLMs, we hope SOMA will inspire future research on body-motion understanding and multimodal reasoning. Full benchmark, training data, and code will be released at: https://cnai.epfl.ch/soma
articles.titleCn: SOMA：细粒度第一人称行为与身体运动理解的基准
articles.abstractCn: 感知人体运动对于理解和协助人类的跨模态系统至关重要。然而，当前对跨模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）的评估主要集中于物体、场景和粗粒度动作，对其推理自身身体的能力评估不足。从第一人称视角来看，这一挑战尤为突出，因为身体只有部分可见，而运动必须从遮挡和时序分布的线索中推断出来。我们引入了SOMA，一个从第一人称视频中进行细粒度身体运动理解的基准，包含1632个经过人工验证的问题，涵盖三个能力维度：身体配置、运动动力学和时序推理。我们评估了37种领先的闭源、开源和专用第一人称MLLMs，并辅以广泛的人工评估。我们发现，仅从视频中完成这项任务对人类来说也很困难（准确率68.5%），但人类明显优于最强的MLLM（Qwen3.6-27B），后者达到了50.0%的零样本准确率。我们的错误分析表明，MLLMs经常误读穿着者的自身身体，误判事件发生的时间，并倾向于出现偏爱右手或重复次数计数不足等偏见。为了缩小与人类表现的差距并支持进一步发展，我们引入了一个对齐的视频、身体运动和语言监督的训练数据集，以及一个联合学习这些模态的多模态基线。通过识别当前MLLMs中常见的失效模式和缺失能力，我们希望SOMA能够启发未来关于身体运动理解和跨模态推理的研究。完整的基准、训练数据和代码将在以下地址发布：https://cnai.epfl.ch/soma

articles.title: AK_QMUL at ArGuard Shared Tasks: A Single Fine-Tuned JAIS for Arabic Harmful-Prompt Detection
articles.abstract: We present AK_QMUL's submissions to the ArGuard-2026 shared tasks on Arabic harmful-prompt detection: a binary safe/unsafe task (B1) and a seven-way harm-domain task (B2). Both submissions use one backbone -- JAIS-6.7B fine-tuned with 4-bit QLoRA and a linear classification head over its last-token representation. For B1 we train a four-way head that factors the label by dialect register {safe, unsafe} x {MSA, other}, we augment the training fold with MSA prompts from AraSafe, and decode with a plain argmax to score safe/unsafe. For B2 we fine-tune the same backbone as a seven-way classifier and average the softmax outputs of five random seeds. Both submissions ranked first on their track, with macro-F1 0.984 on B1 and 0.790 on B2. We report results by dialect and by class: on B1 the model is accurate across all six dialects (93.6--99.8%) and its predicted unsafe rate tracks the true rate closely; on B2 six of the seven classes reach F1 between 0.73 and 0.98, with the residual error concentrated in the Bully class, which overlaps semantically with harassment and harm-to-others.
articles.comment: Published at ArabicNLP 2026 (Shared Tasks), co-located with EMNLP 2026. ACL Anthology: https://aclanthology.org/2026.arabicnlp-sharedtasks.43/
articles.titleCn: AK_QMUL在ArGuard共享任务中：一个用于阿拉伯语有害提示检测的单个微调JAIS
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了AK_QMUL在ArGuard-2026共享任务中关于阿拉伯语有害提示检测的提交：一个二元安全/不安全任务（B1）和一个七类危害领域任务（B2）。两个提交都使用同一个主干网络——JAIS-6.7B，使用4位QLoRA进行微调，并在其最后一个token表示上添加一个线性分类头。对于B1，我们训练了一个四类分类头，将标签分解为方言语域{安全，不安全} x {MSA，其他}，使用AraSafe的MSA提示增强训练折，并使用简单的argmax解码来评分安全/不安全。对于B2，我们微调了相同的主干网络作为七类分类器，并平均五个随机种子的softmax输出。两个提交在其赛道中都排名第一，B1的宏观F1为0.984，B2的宏观F1为0.790。我们按方言和类别报告结果：在B1中，模型在所有六种方言中都具有准确性（93.6--99.8%），其预测的不安全率与真实率紧密跟踪；在B2中，七类中的六类F1值在0.73到0.98之间，残余误差集中在Bully类别，该类别在语义上与骚扰和伤害他人重叠。

articles.title: Detect Before You Disambiguate: Perturbation-Based Input Ambiguity Detection in LLMs
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often answer ambiguous inputs as if they had a single intended meaning. This is problematic because input ambiguity is an upstream source of uncertainty: when a prompt admits multiple valid interpretations, the key question is whether the model should answer directly at all. Existing input uncertainty methods often rely on LLM-generated statements or clarifications, but such transformations may already disambiguate the input before the ambiguity is measured. We propose a label-preserving perturbation framework for input ambiguity detection in which perturbations remain close to the original input while preserving its label. We instantiate this principle with two detectors: a black-box rule-based perturbation library and a white-box importance-guided method using model-internal signals. Experiments across four datasets in open-domain, conversational, and visual QA show that our methods outperform output-side uncertainty baselines and LLM-paraphrase-based perturbation baselines. Our results highlight the importance of detecting ambiguity before attempting to disambiguate it. Our code is available \href{https://github.com/Xiao0o0o/input-ambiguity-detection}{\textcolor{purple}{here}}.
articles.titleCn: 在消除歧义之前进行检测：LLMs中的基于扰动的输入歧义检测
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）通常将模糊输入视为具有单一预期含义来回答，这存在一个问题，因为输入模糊性是上游不确定性来源：当提示允许多种有效解释时，关键问题是模型是否应该直接回答。现有的输入不确定性方法通常依赖于LLM生成的陈述或澄清，但此类转换可能在测量模糊性之前就已经消除了输入的模糊性。我们提出了一种标签保留扰动框架，用于输入模糊性检测，其中扰动保持接近原始输入，同时保留其标签。我们通过两个检测器实例化了这一原则：一个黑盒基于规则的扰动库和一个使用模型内部信号的白色盒重要性引导方法。在开放域、对话和视觉问答四个数据集上的实验表明，我们的方法优于输出侧不确定性基线和基于LLM释义的扰动基线。我们的结果强调了在尝试消除模糊性之前检测模糊性的重要性。我们的代码可在 \href{https://github.com/Xiao0o0o/input-ambiguity-detection}{\textcolor{purple}{此处}} 获取。

articles.title: Cross-modal Steering Vectors Exist Across Both Image and Text Generation
articles.abstract: Are concepts and mechanisms unified across modalities in current AI models, or instead implemented separately for each one? We operationalize this broad question of modality unification by studying cross-modal steering: 1) finding vectors that successfully steer generation on tokens of one modality, which then 2) transfer zero-shot to steer generation when added to tokens of another modality. Our study goes beyond simple correlational alignment (e.g. representational similarity) because steering is fundamentally causal. We study cross-modal steering in several unified multimodal models (UMMs), since they possess shared parameters for language and image generation, focusing on these two modalities. Across diverse steered concepts such as emotion and object size, we show that steering vectors transfer zero-shot in both directions (text-to-image & image-to-text). Even for concepts that are highly unique to one modality (e.g. formal vs. colloquial language), steering vectors often induce a consistent, interpretable effect in the other modality, such as formal clothing and design. This transfer has a geometric signature too: despite a clear modality gap separating text and image representations, steering vectors with strong cross-modal transferability tend to point in similar directions for the same concept. Our findings shed light on how vision and language interact inside unified multimodal models and point towards more general, modality-agnostic approaches for controlling their behavior.
articles.titleCn: 跨模态引导向量同时存在于图像和文本生成中
articles.abstractCn: 当前AI模型中，概念和机制是在不同模态间统一的，还是为每个模态单独实现的？我们通过研究跨模态引导来具体化这一关于模态统一性的广泛问题：1) 找到能够成功引导某一模态标记生成的向量，然后2) 将这些向量添加到另一模态的标记上，实现零样本迁移以引导生成。我们的研究超越了简单的相关性对齐（例如表征相似性），因为引导本质上具有因果性。我们研究了几个统一的多模态模型（UMMs）中的跨模态引导，因为这些模型在语言和图像生成方面具有共享参数，重点关注这两种模态。在多种不同的引导概念（如情感和物体大小）中，我们展示了引导向量在两个方向（文本到图像和图像到文本）上都能实现零样本迁移。即使是那些高度属于某一模态的独特概念（例如正式与非正式语言），引导向量也常常在另一模态中产生一致且可解释的效果，例如正式服装和设计。这种迁移具有几何特征：尽管文本和图像表征之间存在明显的模态鸿沟，但具有强跨模态迁移能力的引导向量对于同一概念往往指向相似的方向。我们的发现揭示了视觉和语言在统一多模态模型内部的相互作用，并指明了更通用、模态无关的方法来控制其行为。

articles.title: Beyond IceBERT: Open-Data ModernBERT Encoders for Icelandic from 12M to 1B Parameters
articles.abstract: IceBERT, the reference encoder for Icelandic, found that a cleaned web crawl is enough to train a strong model and that starting from a multilingual model can help on some tasks. We revisit both findings with the ModernBERT architecture. We train Icelandic encoders from 12M to 1B parameters on 9B tokens of open data, and rerun IceBERT's benchmarks and five newer tasks for 30 encoders under one protocol with confidence intervals. Our 1B model trained from scratch, to our knowledge the first monolingual Icelandic encoder of that size, is significantly better than IceBERT on all eleven tasks; warm-started from the English Ettin encoder of the same shape, it has the best score of all encoders on every task we rank. Because our model shapes match the English Ettin encoders and the multilingual mmBERT, we can also test the warm start under controlled conditions, at six model sizes and four token budgets. With our vocabulary transplanted, a warm start was never significantly worse than scratch training on the same Icelandic text, and from base size up it was not significantly worse on four tasks than scratch training on 4 times the text (8 times at base and 1B). As models grow, most of the transfer comes from the source model's transformer layers, so even an English source helps. Keeping the source vocabulary instead cost 5 F1 on question answering and nearly three times the compute.
articles.titleCn: 超越IceBERT：面向冰岛的开放数据ModernBERT编码器参数从12M扩展至1B
articles.abstractCn: IceBERT，冰岛语参考编码器发现，一个清理过的网络爬取数据足以训练一个强大的模型，并且从多语言模型开始有助于某些任务。我们使用ModernBERT架构重新审视了这两个发现。我们在90亿个开放数据上训练了从1200万到10亿参数的冰岛语编码器，并在一个协议下重新运行了IceBERT的基准测试和五个更新的任务，共30个编码器，并提供了置信区间。据我们所知，我们从头训练的10亿参数模型，是目前最大的单语冰岛语编码器，在所有11个任务上都显著优于IceBERT；从相同结构的英语Ettin编码器进行热启动，它在所有我们排名的任务中都获得了最佳分数。由于我们的模型结构与英语Ettin编码器和多语言mmBERT相同，我们还可以在受控条件下测试热启动，包括六个模型大小和四个标记预算。通过移植我们的词汇，热启动从未显著差于在同一冰岛语文本上的从头训练，并且从基础大小开始，它在四个任务上从未显著差于在四倍文本（基础大小为8倍，10亿参数为1倍）上的从头训练。随着模型的增长，大部分迁移来自源模型的Transformer层，因此即使是英语源也有帮助。保留源词汇则导致问答任务F1值损失5分，并几乎使计算量增加近三倍。

articles.title: Base Models Can Detect Hidden Intentions that Prompted Classifiers Miss
articles.abstract: The Persona Selection Model (PSM) posits that post-training selects a persona the model learned during pre-training. Work on subliminal learning has shown that models can impart covert signals (like "love of owls") into semantically unrelated outputs like strings of numbers, and that students trained on these outputs inherit those traits. In this work I show that by evaluating the likelihood of such outputs under the base pre-trained model with an appropriate header, a method I call persona-header likelihood evaluation (PHLE), one can decode these subliminal signals and classify between them. For example, PHLE distinguishes number sequences generated by a post-trained model prompted with "You love owls" from those prompted with "You love eagles", and distinguishes answers from a model with a secret desire to harm the user, filtered to remove any noticeable misalignment, from those of a model with no system prompt. In both cases prompted classifiers, including the generating model itself, remain near chance. The signal partially persists across model families, with the Qwen base model reading signals generated by Olmo and vice versa. This is evidence for a non-trivial prediction of the PSM, and the method may be practically useful for auditing the hidden objectives of models.
articles.titleCn: 基础模型能够检测分类器所遗漏的引发意图的隐藏意图。
articles.abstractCn: 人格选择模型（PSM）提出，在训练后选择一个模型在预训练期间学习到的人格。潜意识学习的研究表明，模型可以将隐蔽信号（如“喜欢猫头鹰”）传递到语义上无关的输出（如一串数字），而接受这些输出训练的学生会继承这些特质。在这项工作中，我展示了通过使用适当的标题评估基础预训练模型下此类输出的可能性，我称之为人格-标题可能性评估（PHLE），人们可以解码这些潜意识信号并将它们分类。例如，PHLE可以区分由提示“你喜欢猫头鹰”的后训练模型生成的数字序列和由提示“你喜欢鹰”生成的序列，还可以区分一个有秘密伤害用户愿望的模型生成的答案（经过过滤以去除任何明显的偏差）和一个没有系统提示的模型生成的答案。在这两种情况下，提示分类器（包括生成模型本身）仍然接近随机。信号在模型家族之间部分持续存在，Qwen基础模型可以读取由Olmo生成的信号，反之亦然。这是对PSM的一个非平凡的预测证据，该方法可能对审计模型的隐藏目标具有实际用途。

articles.title: Learning to Read Braille: Benchmarking and Improving Braille Recognition Capabilities of VLMs
articles.abstract: Despite rapid progress in visual understanding and document transcription, modern vision-language models (VLMs) struggle with a fundamental accessibility task: reading Braille from images. We introduce BrailleBench, a manually curated benchmark of 259 real-world Grade-1 and Grade-2 Braille images. We evaluate proprietary, open-weight, OCR-specialized, and tool-assisted multimodal systems and find that standalone general-purpose models perform poorly at directly transcribing Braille images, whereas tool-assisted systems perform much better. We design a synthetic Braille generation pipeline with diverse layouts and image perturbations. A 2B VLM model trained on our synthetic data reaches 87% exact match on Grade-1 and 61% on Grade-2 BrailleBench, outperforming standalone VLMs and achieving the highest Grade-2 exact match score among the evaluated systems. We further show that high accuracy on synthetic validation data does not guarantee high accuracy on real photographs in our experiments: models trained on prior synthetic data reach up to 96% on their synthetic validation set but at most 3.26% on Grade-1 BrailleBench. Our results identify an accessibility-relevant capability gap in multimodal systems and show that targeted synthetic supervision can improve real-world Braille transcription.
articles.comment: 22 pages, 8 figures, 16 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/kartik0806/BrailleBench
articles.titleCn: 学习阅读盲文：基准测试和改进视觉语言模型（VLMs）的盲文识别能力
articles.abstractCn: 尽管在视觉理解和文档转录方面取得了快速进展，现代视觉语言模型（VLMs）在阅读图像中的盲文这一基本可访问性任务上仍面临挑战。我们介绍了BrailleBench，这是一个包含259张真实世界一级和二级盲文图像的手动标注基准。我们评估了专有、开源权重、OCR专业和工具辅助的多模态系统，发现独立通用的模型在直接转录盲文图像方面表现不佳，而工具辅助系统则表现更好。我们设计了一个具有多样化布局和图像扰动的合成盲文生成流程。一个在合成数据上训练的2B VLM模型在盲文Bench上达到了87%的一级盲文精确匹配率和61%的二级盲文精确匹配率，优于独立的VLM模型，并取得了评估系统中最高的二级盲文精确匹配分数。我们进一步表明，在合成验证数据上的高精度并不保证在真实照片上的高精度：在先前合成数据上训练的模型在合成验证集上达到高达96%的精度，但在一级盲文Bench上最多只有3.26%。我们的结果表明多模态系统存在与可访问性相关的能力差距，并表明有针对性的合成监督可以改善现实世界的盲文转录。

articles.title: LLM Hallucination Detection via Low-rank Multilinear Decomposition
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) frequently generate fluent yet factually incorrect responses, raising concerns about their reliability. Recent hallucination detectors increasingly exploit internal representations, but extracting informative signals from high-dimensional hidden states remains challenging. Existing approaches often rely on selected activations or pooling-based compression, potentially overlooking discriminative information distributed across Transformer layers, feature modes, and tokens. We propose LOTUS (Low-rank Order-statistic TUcker-based Subspace learning), a multilinear low-rank decomposition framework for hallucination detection that extracts compact representations from LLM hidden states while reducing dependence on labeled data. Our approach first summarizes variable-length token representations using complementary statistical descriptors that capture peak activations, activation distributions, and cross-layer changes. We then leverage low-rank multilinear decomposition to extract compact representations that capture the underlying structure of LLM hidden states, which are subsequently used to train a lightweight hallucination classifier. Experiments across multiple LLMs and question-answering benchmarks demonstrate improved hallucination detection performance over recent state-of-the-art baselines.
articles.titleCn: 基于低秩多线性分解的LLM幻觉检测
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）经常生成流畅但事实错误的内容，引发了对其可靠性的担忧。近期的研究中，幻觉检测器越来越多地利用内部表征，但从高维隐藏状态中提取信息性信号仍然具有挑战性。现有方法通常依赖于选定的激活或基于池化的压缩，可能忽略了分布在整个Transformer层、特征模式和标记中的判别信息。我们提出了LOTUS（基于低秩排序统计Tucker的子空间学习），这是一种用于幻觉检测的多线性低秩分解框架，它从LLM隐藏状态中提取紧凑表征，同时减少对标记数据的依赖。我们的方法首先使用互补统计描述符对变长标记表征进行总结，这些描述符能够捕捉峰值激活、激活分布和跨层变化。然后，我们利用低秩多线性分解来提取紧凑表征，这些表征能够捕捉LLM隐藏状态的底层结构，随后用于训练轻量级的幻觉分类器。在多个LLM和问答基准上的实验表明，与近期的最先进基线相比，我们的方法在幻觉检测性能上有所提升。

articles.title: Frankly Speaking: The Company Election Integrity Keeps in Congressional Communication
articles.abstract: Election integrity is a shared commitment in American politics, but Democrats and Republicans in Congress increasingly mean different things by it. Analyzing 10,420 congressional e-newsletters sent from 2010 to 2025, we examine how the two parties invoke election terms such as ``integrity,'' ``security,'' and ``fraud.'' Using diachronic word embeddings, which track semantic change through how words are used in context, we measure how differently each party uses each term, how much each party shifts, and whether they share nearest semantic neighbors. We show that members of Congress do not need different words to tell different stories about elections. They need only place those same words in different company. Across nearly every term and year, the two parties surround election-integrity vocabulary with entirely different words. That divergence is easy to miss, because most election vocabulary is no more divergent than other words used at roughly the same frequency, and neither party's usage shifted more than the other's. Only a subset of terms grew more divergent, most notably ``certification,'' while ``rigged'' and ``stolen'' entered election discourse after 2020 and polarized there. By 2024, Democrats surround ``voter,'' ``election,'' and ``integrity'' with the language of access and administration. Republicans surround the same terms with ``citizenship verification,'' ``noncitizen voting,'' and ``border security.'' For one party, integrity means protecting eligible voters' ability to cast a ballot. For the other, it means protecting the electoral process from illegitimate ballots. Election officials, who must administer a single system under both definitions, inherit this tension.
articles.titleCn: 坦率地说：公司选举诚信保持在国会沟通中的公司
articles.abstractCn: 选举诚信是美国政治的共同承诺，但国会中的民主党和共和党对此日益有不同的理解。通过分析2010年至2025年间发送的10,420封国会电子简报，我们考察了这两个政党如何使用诸如“诚信”、“安全”和“欺诈”等选举术语。利用历时词嵌入技术——该技术通过追踪词语在语境中的使用来监测语义变化——我们测量了每个政党使用每个术语的差异程度、各自的转变幅度以及它们是否共享最接近的语义邻域。研究表明，国会成员无需使用不同的词语来讲述不同的选举故事，他们只需将这些相同的词语置于不同的语境中。在几乎所有术语和年份中，两党都围绕选举诚信词汇使用了截然不同的词语。这种差异很容易被忽视，因为大多数选举词汇与其他使用频率相近的词语并无太大差异，且两党的使用频率变化程度相当。只有少数术语的差异加剧，尤其是“认证”一词，而“被操纵”和“被盗”则在2020年后进入选举话语，并在其中加剧了分歧。到2024年，民主党围绕“选民”、“选举”和“诚信”使用与准入和管理相关的语言，而共和党则围绕这些术语使用“公民身份验证”、“非公民投票”和“边境安全”。对一方而言，诚信意味着保护符合条件的选民投票的权利；对另一方而言，诚信意味着保护选举过程免受非法选票的干扰。必须根据这两种定义管理单一系统的选举官员，继承了这种张力。

articles.title: Lipi-Ghor: A Large-Scale, Diarized, Multi-Domain Bengali Speech Corpus and a Scalable Pipeline for Building It
articles.abstract: Bengali, spoken by over 230 million people, remains severely under-resourced in spoken language research. Existing open Bengali ASR corpora are confined to short, read or crowd-sourced speech and lack speaker diarization and long-form audio. We present Lipi-Ghor, a large-scale weakly-supervised Bengali speech corpus comprising 885 hours of audio sourced from 998 YouTube videos across 596 unique channels, spanning 17 diverse domains including audiobooks, drama, religious sermons, news, and regional dialects. Each recording is annotated in SSTT format (Speaker, Speech, Transcription, Timestamp), which combines automated diarization with Bengali YouTube caption tracks. To our knowledge, Lipi-Ghor is the first Bengali speech corpus to pair large-scale coverage with speaker-diarized, long-form audio annotations, both of which are absent from existing open Bengali resources. We also present the construction methodology as a replicable pipeline for any language with a sufficient captioned YouTube presence. Targeted channel curation across a handful of rich domains yields corpus scales that were previously out of reach for low-resource languages. We benchmark four widely-used ASR models under zero-shot and fine-tuned conditions. All four degrade consistently on emotive, dialectal, and long-form content. Because caption targets are noisy, we also release a human-annotated gold evaluation split, verified by 17 volunteer annotators over 30 hours of human-in-the-loop correction and stratified across all 17 domains. We release our original contributions (video-ID lists, diarization output, pipeline code, and the gold annotations) under CC-BY-4.0, and distribute caption-derived transcripts for research use only; no raw audio is redistributed.
articles.comment: 12 pages, 7 figures. Published in the Proceedings of the Speech and Audio Language Models Workshop (2nd Edition), pages 190-201, 2026
articles.titleCn: Lipi-Ghor：一个大规模、多人声识别、多领域的孟加拉语语音语料库及其构建的可扩展流程
articles.abstractCn: 孟加拉语，由超过2.3亿人使用，在口语语言研究方面仍然严重资源匮乏。现有的公开孟加拉语语音识别语料库仅限于简短、朗读或众包的语音，缺乏说话人分割和长音频内容。我们提出了Lipi-Ghor，一个大规模弱监督孟加拉语语音语料库，包含885小时的音频，来源于998个YouTube视频，涉及596个独特频道，涵盖17个不同领域，包括有声读物、戏剧、宗教布道、新闻和地方方言。每条录音均以SSTT格式（说话人、语音、转录文本、时间戳）进行标注，结合了自动说话人分割和孟加拉语YouTube字幕轨道。据我们所知，Lipi-Ghor是首个结合大规模覆盖和说话人分割、长音频标注的孟加拉语音语料库，而现有公开孟加拉语资源中均缺乏这些特性。我们还介绍了构建方法，将其作为一个可复制的流程，适用于任何拥有足够字幕的YouTube语言的构建。在少数丰富领域的频道筛选下，语料库规模达到了低资源语言此前难以企及的水平。我们在零样本和微调条件下对四种广泛使用的语音识别模型进行了基准测试。所有四种模型在情感化、方言和长音频内容上均表现退化。由于字幕目标存在噪声，我们还发布了一个人工标注的金标准评估分割，由17名志愿者在30小时的人机交互修正中验证，并按所有17个领域分层。我们以CC-BY-4.0许可发布我们的原创贡献（视频ID列表、说话人分割输出、流程代码和金标准标注），并仅限研究用途分发字幕衍生转录文本；不重新分发原始音频。

articles.title: 3, 7, 14, 17, 42: Instruction Tuning Installs and Sharpens Number-Choice Heuristics in Language Models
articles.abstract: We measure, without sampling error, the probability a language model assigns to each integer from 1 to N when asked for a random number. For a fixed prompt the model defines one probability vector, which we compute by summing over each integer's scored spellings rather than estimate by sampling, removing the noise that limits earlier studies [1, 4]. We evaluate 18 open-weight model lines at five ranges up to N = 100, under 29 decoding configurations, on two inference stacks; 15 of them have matched base and instruction-tuned checkpoints that both give usable answers. Instruction tuning makes the distribution less uniform in all 15 pairs. It installs one heuristic, round-number avoidance, and sharpens another, endpoint avoidance. Base checkpoints do not avoid round numbers once the endpoints are removed from those sets; tuned checkpoints avoid them, multiples of 10 almost completely. Base checkpoints return the endpoints 1 and N at 0.30 to 0.60 of the interior rate; tuned checkpoints almost never return them. A preference for odd numbers is consistent across tuned checkpoints only at N = 100, where base checkpoints also show it weakly. Endpoint avoidance and the odd preference fit the account Kubovy and Psotka [6] proposed for human number choice; round-number avoidance is not part of that account, and the midpoint avoidance it predicts is essentially absent, with one slight exception at N = 100. Tuning does not install a new favourite integer shared across models: above N = 10 no modal integer is shared by more than 42 percent of tuned conditions, and P (17) rises in 10 of 15 pairs and falls in 5. The concentration is present in the model's own distribution: at temperature 1.0, nucleus truncation at top-p 0.95 adds a median of 0.035 to the total variation distance.
articles.titleCn: 3, 7, 14, 17, 42：指令微调在语言模型中安装和锐化了数字选择启发式方法
articles.abstractCn: 我们无采样误差地测量语言模型为1到N的每个整数分配的概率，当模型被要求生成随机数时。对于固定的提示，模型定义一个概率向量，我们通过求和每个整数的得分拼写来计算它，而不是通过采样来估计，从而消除了限制早期研究[1, 4]的噪声。我们在两个推理堆栈上，对18条开放权重模型线在N=100的五种范围内，通过29种解码配置进行评估；其中15条具有匹配的基础和指令微调检查点，两者都能给出可用答案。指令微调使15对中的分布不再均匀。它引入了一种启发式方法，即避免整数值，并加强了另一种，即避免端点。基础检查点在移除端点后不再避免整数值；微调检查点避免它们，几乎完全避免10的倍数。基础检查点在内部率的30%到60%时返回端点1和N；微调检查点几乎从不返回它们。对奇数的偏好仅在N=100时在微调检查点中一致，其中基础检查点也表现出微弱的偏好。端点避免和对奇数的偏好符合Kubovy和Psotka[6]为人类数字选择提出的解释；整数值避免不是该解释的一部分，并且它预测的中点避免实际上几乎不存在，只有一个在N=100时的轻微例外。微调没有在模型之间安装一个新的共同偏好的整数：在N>10时，没有超过42%的微调条件共享模态整数，并且在15对中的10对中P(17)上升，在5对中下降。这种集中体现在模型的分布中：在温度1.0下，top-p 0.95的核截断将总变分距离的中位数增加了0.035。

articles.title: Don't Pick a Winner: Knowledge Conflicts Need a Prior, Not a Rule
articles.abstract: A retrieval-augmented language model answers from two sources, the retrieved context and its own knowledge, and the two disagree whenever the context is incomplete or wrong. Existing methods settle the disagreement with a rule fixed at design time: follow the context, amplify it in proportion to how far it moves the model, or trust the model's memory. Each rule is confidently wrong in some deployment. In a decision-theoretic model of two sources, the score of any fixed rule is linear in the share of reliable contexts while the best attainable score is convex, so every fixed rule is beaten wherever it is not exactly optimal; and a symmetric divergence between the two sources, the signal adaptive decoding uses, carries no information about which one is right. Resolving a conflict therefore needs two inputs that no existing method keeps: evidence about each source separately, and a prior on how often the context is right. We test these claims on GRACE, a benchmark that intervenes on the knowledge-graph context of a fixed question, so that what the model knows, what the context says and what is true are measured separately. There, every baseline from four families is strong on right contexts or on wrong ones, never on both. We then build the two inputs: the model states its knowledge as notes, a small policy voices each note with a calibrated confidence, a reader answers in two voices, and a selector commits or abstains under a prior $π$ applied as an exact prior shift. With $π$ set to the true share of right contexts, the system is above the best baseline at every mixture of GRACE contexts, by up to 26 points. Its overall score is 45.3 and 35.0 (Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, Llama-3.1-8B), against 29.4 and 27.5 for the best baseline. On preregistered ClashEval it beats same-backbone CK-PLUG and TCR by 12 and 26 points. Where the model lacks the knowledge, the gains vanish, as the theory predicts.
articles.comment: 49 pages (9 main text + appendix and supplementary material), 14 figures
articles.titleCn: 不要挑选赢家：知识冲突需要先验条件，而非规则
articles.abstractCn: 一个检索增强型语言模型从两个来源回答问题：检索到的上下文和模型自身的知识，当上下文不完整或错误时，这两个来源会不一致。现有方法通过在设计时固定的规则来解决这种不一致：遵循上下文、根据上下文对模型的影响程度按比例放大上下文，或信任模型的记忆。每个规则在某些部署场景中都可能是错误的。在一个关于两个来源的决策理论模型中，任何固定规则的得分与可靠上下文的份额呈线性关系，而最佳可达到的得分是凸形的，因此每个固定规则在非最优情况下都会被超越；而两个来源之间对称的偏差，信号自适应解码所使用的，并不能提供关于哪个来源正确的任何信息。因此，解决冲突需要现有方法未能保留的两个输入：关于每个来源的独立证据，以及上下文正确的先验概率。我们在GRACE上测试了这些主张，GRACE是一个基准测试，它干预固定问题的知识图谱上下文，以便分别测量模型所知的内容、上下文所说的内容以及真实情况。在那里，来自四个系列的每个基线在正确上下文或错误上下文上表现强劲，但从不两者兼优。然后我们构建了这两个输入：模型将其知识表述为笔记，一个小型策略用校准的置信度对每条笔记进行发声，一个读者用两种声音回答，一个选择器在先验概率π下决定或弃权，π作为精确先验偏移量应用。当π设置为正确上下文的真实份额时，该系统在GRACE上下文的每种混合情况下都优于最佳基线，最高提升26分。其总得分为45.3和35.0（Qwen3.5-35B-A3B，Llama-3.1-8B），而最佳基线的得分分别为29.4和27.5。在预先注册的ClashEval上，它比同骨干CK-PLUG和TCR分别高出12分和26分。当模型缺乏知识时，收益消失，正如理论所预测的那样。

articles.title: ConformalMOS: Uncertainty-Aware MOS Prediction with Conformal Intervals and Ordinal Modeling
articles.abstract: Accurate prediction of human Mean Opinion Scores (MOS) is crucial for evaluating synthetic speech quality in text-to-speech (TTS) and voice conversion (VC). Most MOS predictors output only point estimates and ignore uncertainty, limiting reliability in model selection and deployment. We propose ConformalMOS, a framework that augments MOS prediction with conformal prediction to produce statistically valid prediction intervals with guaranteed coverage under exchangeability, alongside point estimates. During training, MOS labels are modeled in an ordinal-aware manner by converting one-hot targets into Gaussian-smoothed distributions, preserving score ordering. This improves uncertainty calibration, particularly when softmax confidence is overconfident on out-of-distribution speech. On BVCC datasets, ConformalMOS achieves competitive accuracy (MSE = 0.08) while delivering empirically validated coverage, enhancing reliability for real-world TTS and VC deployment.
articles.titleCn: 保形MOS：基于保形区间和序数建模的不确定性感知MOS预测
articles.abstractCn: 准确预测人类平均意见分数（MOS）对于评估文本到语音（TTS）和语音转换（VC）中的合成语音质量至关重要。大多数MOS预测器仅输出点估计并忽略不确定性，从而限制了模型选择和部署的可靠性。我们提出了ConformalMOS框架，该框架通过结合一致性预测来增强MOS预测，在可交换性下生成具有保证覆盖率的统计有效预测区间，同时提供点估计。在训练过程中，通过将one-hot目标转换为高斯平滑分布来以序数感知的方式建模MOS标签，从而保留分数顺序。这提高了不确定性校准，特别是在softmax置信度对分布外语音过度自信时。在BVCC数据集上，ConformalMOS实现了具有竞争力的精度（MSE = 0.08），同时提供了经验验证的覆盖率，增强了现实世界TTS和VC部署的可靠性。

articles.title: Beyond Update Counts: A Control Map for Evaluating Test-Time Model Updates
articles.abstract: Test-time updating lets a language model change persistent state after training---such as model weights, adapter parameters, or a memory module---before or while answering queries. Existing evaluations often compare systems using update count or frequency and performance measured immediately afterward. These summaries omit what is updated, where, when, and in what order. The same total can therefore hide an important difference: one system may answer after one update while another answers after two. We introduce the Control Map, an evaluation framework that records the committed updates preceding each scored answer and separately evaluates behavioral changes, immediate learning (acquisition), later recall (retention), preservation of unrelated behavior (locality), and performance in new settings. We prove when counts alone determine final state and show, under stated assumptions, how differences between pre-answer histories limit differences in average scores. Using ControlMap, our experiments reveal three insights. First, update scheduling matters: at a 760M-parameter checkpoint, 24 schedules with the same update count yield 19.7%--34.2% accuracy. Second, learning an edit does not guarantee that it lasts or remains contained: all six selected CounterFact LoRA settings learn the new information, while ROME retains edits at all 13 operating points but fails locality at each. Third, no editor performs best consistently across models, benchmarks, and tests. Evaluations should therefore report update histories and assess acquisition, retention, and locality separately.
articles.titleCn: 超越更新计数：评估测试时模型更新的控制图
articles.abstractCn: 测试时更新允许语言模型在训练后改变持久状态——例如模型权重、适配器参数或内存模块——在回答查询之前或同时。现有的评估通常通过更新次数或频率以及随后的性能来比较系统。这些摘要省略了更新的内容、位置、时间和顺序。因此，相同的总数可能隐藏着一个重要差异：一个系统可能更新一次后回答，而另一个系统更新两次后回答。我们引入了控制图（Control Map），这是一个评估框架，记录了每个得分回答之前提交的更新，并分别评估行为变化、即时学习（获取）、后期回忆（保持）、无关行为的保留（局部性）以及新环境中的性能。我们证明了当计数单独决定最终状态时，并在假设条件下，展示了预回答历史之间的差异如何限制平均分数的差异。使用控制图，我们的实验揭示了三点见解。首先，更新调度很重要：在76亿参数的检查点，24种具有相同更新次数的调度产生了19.7%--34.2%的准确率。其次，学习一个编辑并不保证它能持续或保持局限：所有六个选定的CounterFact LoRA设置都学习了新信息，而ROME在所有13个操作点都保留了编辑，但在每个点都失败了局部性。第三，没有编辑器能在所有模型、基准和测试中始终表现最佳。因此，评估应该报告更新历史，并分别评估获取、保持和局部性。

articles.title: FinLLM-KG: Knowledge Graph-Enhanced LLMs for Financial Sentiment Analysis in Algorithmic Trading
articles.abstract: Recent advances in Generative AI have substantially improved financial sentiment analysis through post-trained financial large language models (LLMs). However, existing approaches remain confined to predicting the sentiment of each article in isolation and operate as black boxes, which limits contextual understanding and hinders deployment in high-stakes financial decision-making. To this end, we introduce FinLLM-KG, a model-agnostic framework that combines causal LLMs with a financial knowledge graph, in order to inject temporally grounded, company-level knowledge from SEC 10-K filings at inference time, without updating model weights. Within FinLLM-KG, context is supplied either as a natural-language company profile or as a small set of relevance-ranked factual triples. This enables sentiment predictions to account for broader firm-level information rather than the article alone, at almost zero computational cost and for any causal LLM. In addition, attributing each article-level sentiment score to individual sentences and to the retrieved knowledge-graph facts makes the evidence behind the prediction inspectable, thereby enhancing explainability and supporting human-in-the-loop review. Simulations demonstrate that FinLLM-KG consistently improves portfolio performance over the state-of-the-art baseline.
articles.titleCn: FinLLM-KG：算法交易中用于金融情感分析的图增强大型语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 生成式人工智能的最新进展通过预训练的金融大型语言模型（LLM）显著提升了金融情绪分析能力。然而，现有方法仍局限于孤立地预测每篇文章的情绪，且如同黑箱操作，这限制了上下文理解，阻碍了其在高风险金融决策中的部署。为此，我们引入了FinLLM-KG，这是一个模型无关的框架，它结合了因果LLM与金融知识图谱，旨在在不更新模型权重的情况下，在推理时注入来自美国证券交易委员会10-K报告的、基于时间、公司层面的知识。在FinLLM-KG中，上下文可以通过自然语言的公司简介或一组相关性排序的事实三元组提供。这使得情绪预测能够考虑更广泛的公司层面信息，而非仅限于文章本身，且计算成本几乎为零，适用于任何因果LLM。此外，将每篇文章的情绪得分归因于单个句子和检索到的知识图谱事实，使得预测背后的证据可检查，从而增强了可解释性并支持人机协同审查。模拟结果表明，FinLLM-KG始终优于当前最先进基线，提升了投资组合性能。

articles.title: How Much Does the Hint Matter? Scope Conditions for Hindsight Self-Distillation in Financial Reasoning
articles.abstract: Financial institutions operating under data-residency constraints are restricted to open-weight models small enough to locally host, which trail frontier systems on multi-step quantitative reasoning. On-policy distillation narrows such gaps by supervising a student on its own rollouts, but traditional OPD requires a strong external teacher, and on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) conditions on a full reference solution. We ask how much of that signal is necessary. We present Fin-SD, a localized hindsight self-distillation recipe for multi-step reasoning. Given a problem the student fails, the student itself identifies the first incorrect reasoning step and writes a short critique of that step. We truncate the student's trajectory immediately before the error (aiming to obtain a correct prefix), condition a frozen copy of the student on the same prefix plus the hint, and distill that hint-conditioned teacher into the student over a short rollout under reverse KL. No external model contributes a gradient. We apply Fin-SD to GPT-OSS-20B on a custom multi-step financial reasoning benchmark that requires deriving formula inputs from realistic scenarios via accounting conventions. We find: (i) replacing the critique with a generic-feedback control matches Fin-SD's entire 3.03 pp accuracy gain over the base model on the FinanceReasoning Hard subset, suggesting the gain comes from where supervision is applied, not hint content; (ii) the model writing the hint does not need to be stronger than the model receiving it: hints from same-family GPT-OSS-120B, at roughly 6x the parameters, yield no materially greater benefits than self-written hints; and (iii) Fin-SD matches on-policy self-distillation from full reference solutions on accuracy while generating 9.5% fewer tokens. With Fin-SD, general reasoning on MMLU-Pro and a fourteen-metric compliance audit on FinTrust show no material regression.
articles.comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at the 7th ACM International Conference on AI in Finance (ICAIF '26), Milan, Italy. Code and data: https://github.com/johnnyhyu/fin-sd
articles.titleCn: 提示有多重要？金融推理中后见之明自我蒸馏的范围条件
articles.abstractCn: 受数据驻留限制的金融机构只能使用足够小以供本地部署的开放式权重模型，这些模型在多步量化推理方面落后于前沿系统。策略内蒸馏通过监督学生模型自身的运行来缩小这种差距，但传统的OPD需要强大的外部教师，而策略内自蒸馏（OPSD）则依赖于完整的参考解决方案。我们探究了其中信号必要性的程度。我们提出了Fin-SD，一种用于多步推理的本地化后见自蒸馏方法。当学生模型遇到问题时，模型本身识别出第一个错误的推理步骤，并针对该步骤撰写简短评析。我们立即截断学生模型的轨迹（旨在获得正确的初始前缀），在冻结的学生模型副本上，使用相同的前缀加上提示进行条件化，并通过反向KL散度在短运行中蒸馏该提示条件化的教师模型到学生模型中。没有外部模型贡献梯度。我们将Fin-SD应用于GPT-OSS-20B，在要求通过会计准则从真实场景中推导公式输入的自定义多步金融推理基准上进行测试。我们发现：(i)用通用反馈控制替换评析与Fin-SD在FinanceReasoning Hard子集上相比基础模型的3.03个百分点的准确率提升完全一致，表明提升来源于监督应用的位置而非提示内容；(ii)提供提示的模型无需比接收提示的模型更强：来自同系列的GPT-OSS-120B（参数量约是其6倍）的提示并未带来实质性的更大收益，自写的提示效果相当；(iii)Fin-SD在准确率上与基于完整参考解决方案的策略内自蒸馏相当，同时生成的token数量减少了9.5%。使用Fin-SD，在MMLU-Pro上的通用推理和FinTrust上的十四项合规审计均未出现实质性的性能下降。

articles.title: Center-of-Mass Interpretation of Evolution Strategies
articles.abstract: Evolution strategies (ES) update a model by sampling a population of perturbed copies, scoring each one, and moving in the reward-weighted direction of the perturbations. This update is usually presented as an estimate of a smoothed gradient. We present a geometrical interpretation of this update instead. Treat each perturbed model as a particle and its reward as the particle's mass. Before scoring, every particle has the same mass and the population balances at its centroid. Once rewards are assigned, it balances at its reward-weighted center of mass instead. We show that the mean-subtracted ES update is exactly this displacement, scaled by a scalar factor that depends on the mean reward, for any finite population. The physical reading needs nonnegative rewards, which can always be arranged by adding a constant to every reward without changing the update. In the limit of a large population or under antithetic sampling, the centroid sits on the model itself, so ES has an even simpler geometric interpretation: from its current location, the model moves towards the reward-weighted center of mass of its own population. The same picture explains what subtracting the mean reward does: it changes the point from which the displacement is measured, from the model to the sampled centroid. Our contribution is an intuitive, geometric way to visualize an ES update, exact for any finite population.
articles.titleCn: 质量中心解释进化策略
articles.abstractCn: 进化策略（ES）通过采样一组扰动副本来更新模型，对每个副本进行评分，并在奖励加权的扰动方向上移动。这种更新通常被表述为平滑梯度的估计。我们提出了一种几何解释来描述这种更新。将每个扰动模型视为一个粒子，其奖励作为粒子的质量。在评分之前，每个粒子具有相同的质量，并且种群在质心处平衡。一旦分配了奖励，它就在奖励加权的质心处平衡。我们证明，减去均值的ES更新正好是这种位移，并且对于任何有限种群，都乘以一个与平均奖励相关的标量因子。物理解释需要非负奖励，这总是可以通过对所有奖励加上一个常数而不改变更新来安排。在种群规模很大或使用反采样时，质心位于模型本身上，因此ES具有更简单的几何解释：从当前位置，模型向其自身种群的奖励加权质心移动。同样的图像解释了减去平均奖励的作用：它改变了位移测量的起点，从模型变为采样质心。我们的贡献是一种直观的、几何的方法来可视化ES更新，并且对于任何有限种群都是精确的。

articles.title: Preserve to Expand: Source-Aware Adaptation and Model Merging for Multilingual LLM-Based ASR
articles.abstract: Expanding multilingual ASR systems to new languages is challenging when adaptation must preserve previously supported languages without replaying source-language training data. We study this problem in connector-based Speech LLMs, where a trainable connector maps speech representations into a frozen large language model. We evaluate target-update construction and merging strategies for adapting the connector while preserving source-language performance. In single-target expansion, target-only fine-tuning and standard TIES merging learn new languages but cause severe source-language forgetting, while SSU-Wanda+TIES gives the best source-preserving trade-off. In multi-target expansion, update merging provides stable source retention, whereas recursive expansion can improve target adaptation under favorable orders but is highly order-sensitive. These results show that multilingual ASR expansion requires balancing target acquisition, source retention, and interactions among target-language updates.
articles.titleCn: 保留以扩展：基于多语言大语言模型的语音识别的源感知适应和模型融合
articles.abstractCn: 在将多语言语音识别系统扩展到新语言时，如果需要在不重新播放源语言训练数据的情况下保留先前支持的语言，这将是一项挑战。我们在基于连接器的语音大型语言模型中研究这个问题，其中可训练的连接器将语音表示映射到冻结的大型语言模型。我们评估了在保留源语言性能的同时适应连接器的目标更新构建和合并策略。在单目标扩展中，仅针对目标微调和标准TIES合并学习新语言，但会导致严重的源语言遗忘，而SSU-Wanda+TIES提供了最佳的源语言保留权衡。在多目标扩展中，更新合并提供了稳定的源保留，而递归扩展在有利顺序下可以改进目标适应，但高度敏感于顺序。这些结果表明，多语言语音识别扩展需要在目标获取、源保留和目标语言更新之间的相互作用之间取得平衡。

articles.title: Understanding Jev-Style System One Models: Does Structure Reduce Selection Bias?
articles.abstract: Selection bias in large language models (LLMs) can persist despite instructions to ignore presentation order or prompts that elicit reasoning. Recent efforts to reproduce Jev-style System One behavior have produced a growing family of models that predict probabilities directly over supplied candidates. Yet systematic comparisons of selection bias across Jev versions, Jev reproductions, and generative LLMs remain limited in multi-option tasks. This leaves a central question: does Jev-style decision structure reduce selection bias? We address this question with a simple test that shuffles options while keeping question and candidate content fixed. Across two Jev versions, twelve Jev reproductions, and six generative LLMs, we trace individual answers through eight presentations and compare them with fixed-order repetition. On our primary collection of 1,700 questions from two benchmarks, Jev's accuracy varies by less than two percentage points, yet its cumulative failure set expands by 27.3--28.5\% relative to the original order, with first failures continuing into the final presentation. Reordering loses substantially more initial successes than fixed-order repetition, a gap that also appears in highly repeatable Jev reproductions. Nor does Jev show a general advantage over the LLM baselines in preserving correct choices. Aggregation offers limited protection: voting yields modest gains for Jev, while even unanimous answers are frequently wrong. These results expose a gap between repeatable decisions and decisions that remain correct across equivalent presentations, showing why stable accuracy alone cannot establish resistance to selection bias.
articles.titleCn: 理解杰夫式系统一模型：结构是否减少选择偏差？
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）中的选择偏差可能即使在指示忽略呈现顺序或引发推理的提示下仍会持续存在。近期为重现Jev风格的系统一行为所做的努力已产生了一系列直接预测所供候选概率的模型。然而，在多选项任务中，对Jev版本、Jev重现和生成式LLMs的选择偏差进行系统性比较仍然有限。这留下了一个核心问题：Jev风格的决策结构能否减少选择偏差？我们通过一个简单测试来回答这个问题，该测试在保持问题和候选内容固定的情况下打乱选项顺序。在两个Jev版本、十二个Jev重现和六个生成式LLMs中，我们追踪个体答案通过八次呈现的过程，并将其与固定顺序重复进行比较。在我们的主要数据集中，包含来自两个基准的1,700个问题，Jev的准确率变化不到两个百分点，但其累积失败集相对于原始顺序扩大了27.3--28.5%，且首次失败会持续到最终呈现。重新排序比固定顺序重复损失了更多的初始成功，这一差距在高度可重复的Jev重现中也同样存在。Jev也没有在保持正确选择方面显示出对LLM基线的普遍优势。聚合提供的保护有限：投票为Jev带来了适度的提升，而即使是一致性答案也经常是错误的。这些结果揭示了可重复决策与在等效呈现中保持正确的决策之间的差距，表明仅凭稳定准确率无法证明对选择偏差的抵抗能力。

articles.title: Learning When to Commit: Schedule Distillation for Fast Diffusion Language Models
articles.abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) can generate multiple tokens in parallel, but often require many decoding rounds to complete a response. Efficient generation depends not only on which tokens are easy to predict, but also on how committing to them helps predict the remaining positions. A highly predictable token may provide little useful context, while revealing a less predictable token can help several other positions become predictable sooner. We propose dSpark, a new schedule distillation-based framework for learning when to commit tokens for faster diffusion language generation. To achieve this, we construct unmasking schedules that prioritize tokens whose reveal makes other positions easier to predict, reducing uncertainty earlier in decoding. We then distill these schedules into the model to enable faster parallel sampling, with a KL-divergence regularizer to help preserve generation quality. We extensively evaluate our approach across mathematical reasoning and code generation tasks. On GSM8K, our method achieves remarkable 10.12$\times$ and 5.12$\times$ speedups over the various baselines on LLaDA-8B-Instruct and Dream-7B-Instruct, respectively, while maintaining superior task performance. Our code is available at https://github.com/VILA-Lab/dSpark.
articles.titleCn: 学习何时提交：快速扩散语言模型的调度蒸馏
articles.abstractCn: 扩散大型语言模型（dLLMs）可以并行生成多个标记，但通常需要多次解码轮次才能完成响应。高效生成不仅取决于哪些标记易于预测，还取决于对它们的确定如何帮助预测剩余位置。一个高度可预测的标记可能提供的有用上下文很少，而揭示一个不太可预测的标记可以帮助其他多个位置更快地变得可预测。我们提出了dSpark，这是一个基于调度蒸馏的新框架，用于学习何时确定标记以实现更快的扩散语言生成。为此，我们构建了去掩码调度，优先考虑那些揭示后使其他位置更容易预测的标记，从而在解码早期减少不确定性。然后我们将这些调度蒸馏到模型中，以实现更快的并行采样，并使用KL散度正则化器来帮助保持生成质量。我们在数学推理和代码生成任务上广泛评估了我们的方法。在GSM8K上，我们的方法在LLaDA-8B-Instruct和Dream-7B-Instruct上分别比各种基线实现了显著的10.12倍和5.12倍加速，同时保持了优越的任务性能。我们的代码可在https://github.com/VILA-Lab/dSpark获取。

articles.title: Quantifying Claim Smoothing by LLM Research Agents
articles.abstract: Deep research, or any use of large language models (LLMs) to read a large document collection and produce insights, requires synthesizing information from different sources. In this work, we find that LLMs produce long-form research reports that read as confident syntheses but which fail to accurately reflect the underlying documents. We call this failure smoothing. In collapsing diverse and potentially conflicting sources into a single narrative, the model discards the evidential "jaggedness" of its corpus and asserts conclusions more decisive than the citations can support. We introduce a claim level scoring pipeline, SmoothScore, to quantify this effect. Our pipeline extracts key conclusive claims from model generated reports, then finds evidence relevant to each claim and clusters that evidence along high level aspects. Finally, each claim is scored with respect to the evidence to quantify the degree of smoothing done by the agent. Across 7 systems and 4 datasets, we find that agents consistently produce stronger claims than warranted.
articles.comment: Code and data present at: https://github.com/tiasa2/SmoothScore
articles.titleCn: 通过LLM研究代理量化主张平滑
articles.abstractCn: 深度研究，或利用大型语言模型（LLM）阅读大量文档集合并生成见解，需要整合来自不同来源的信息。在这项工作中，我们发现LLM生成的长篇研究报告读起来像是自信的综述，但未能准确反映底层文档。我们将这种缺陷称为“平滑化”。在将多样且可能相互冲突的来源压缩成一个单一叙述的过程中，模型丢弃了其语料库的证据“参差不齐性”，并断言比引用所能支持的更为确凿的结论。我们引入了一种声明级别评分流程，SmoothScore，以量化这种效应。我们的流程从模型生成的报告中提取关键的结论性声明，然后找到与每个声明相关的证据，并沿高级别方面对证据进行聚类。最后，根据证据对每个声明进行评分，以量化代理所进行的平滑化程度。在7个系统和4个数据集上，我们发现代理始终生成比应有的更强的声明。

articles.title: Atomic Security Concerns: Towards a Foundational Language for Security Knowledge Representation
articles.abstract: Cybersecurity governance, risk management, compliance, and security architecture rely on numerous concepts, including security properties, domains, controls, risks, implementation measures, capabilities, and compliance requirements. Although these concepts are widely used, they are often represented through heterogeneous abstractions and vocabularies, making relationships among them difficult to express consistently and leaving much of the associated reasoning dependent on expert knowledge. This paper introduces the concepts of Security Concerns and Atomic Security Concerns (ASCs) and explores the hypothesis that cybersecurity knowledge may be represented through a finite set of foundational concerns. Inspired by the role of atoms in chemistry, the proposed approach views cybersecurity concepts as compositions of more fundamental concerns rather than as independent abstractions. Hence, Atomic Security Concerns could be viewed as a common abstraction layer for the representation of cybersecurity concepts, independently of their domain, nature, or level of granularity. Building upon this perspective, the paper explores how Atomic Security Concerns may provide the vocabulary of a cybersecurity language and how cybersecurity concepts may be represented as concern sets supporting explicit relationships among concepts. The contribution of this work is intentionally conceptual: it introduces a framework and research hypothesis for investigating the foundations of a common language for cybersecurity knowledge representation, reasoning, and future formalization.
articles.titleCn: 原子安全关切：迈向安全知识表示的基础语言
articles.abstractCn: 网络安全治理、风险管理、合规性和安全架构依赖于众多概念，包括安全属性、领域、控制措施、风险、实施措施、能力和合规要求。尽管这些概念被广泛使用，但它们通常通过异构的抽象和词汇表示，导致它们之间的关系难以一致地表达，并使大量相关推理依赖于专家知识。本文引入了安全关切（Security Concerns）和原子安全关切（Atomic Security Concerns, ASCs）的概念，并探讨了网络安全知识可能通过有限的基础关切集来表示的假设。受化学中原子作用的启发，所提出的方法将网络安全概念视为更基本关切的组合，而非独立的抽象。因此，原子安全关切可以被视为网络安全概念表示的共同抽象层，与其领域、性质或粒度级别无关。基于这一视角，本文探讨了原子安全关切如何为网络安全语言提供词汇，以及网络安全概念如何表示为支持概念间明确关系的关切集。这项工作的贡献是概念性的：它引入了一个框架和一项研究假设，用于研究网络安全知识表示、推理和未来形式化的共同语言的基础。

articles.title: OmniBrain-0: A Unified Agentic Model for Embodied Intelligence
articles.abstract: General-purpose embodied intelligence requires robots to coordinate diverse skills over long horizons, track task progress, and recover from failures. Specialist policies alone do not ensure task-level reliability, while powerful multimodal agents rely on costly reasoning and external experience that compact models struggle to reproduce. We introduce OmniBrain-0, a lightweight unified embodied agent that coordinates manipulation and navigation through a shared high-level decision model, integrating task understanding, planning, progress tracking, and feedback-driven recovery. Our progressive training framework combines embodied pretraining, domain-specialized agent distillation, and multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD). It distills powerful teachers' interaction experience into manipulation and navigation experts, then consolidates their decision capabilities into OmniBrain-0. Unification therefore occurs within the learned decision model rather than only at the tool interface. We further introduce Rubric-Guided Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI), a data flywheel in which a Meta-Agent turns execution evidence into refined rubrics, step-level reminders, and verified trajectories for domain-expert updates before their reconsolidation into OmniBrain-0 through MOPD. We evaluate OmniBrain-0 on LIBERO-Pro, LIBERO-Plus, RoboCasa365, RoboTwin 2.0, and R2R-CE Val-Unseen, as well as multiple real-world manipulation tasks. OmniBrain-0 combines strong cross-domain task performance with substantially lower inference and execution overhead than its closed-source teacher, demonstrating efficient transfer and consolidation of embodied capabilities into a compact unified agent.
articles.comment: Technical Report; 40 pages, 27 figures, 8 tables; Project Page at https://public-bots.github.io/OmniBrain-0/
articles.titleCn: OmniBrain-0：一个用于具身智能的统一智能体模型
articles.abstractCn: 通用具身智能要求机器人能够在长期范围内协调多样化的技能，跟踪任务进度，并从失败中恢复。仅靠专家策略无法保证任务级别的可靠性，而强大的多模态智能体依赖于昂贵推理和外部经验，这些经验紧凑型模型难以复制。我们介绍了 OmniBrain-0，一种轻量级统一具身智能体，它通过共享的高级决策模型协调操作和导航，集成了任务理解、规划、进度跟踪和反馈驱动的恢复。我们的渐进式训练框架结合了具身预训练、领域专用智能体蒸馏和多导师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）。它将强大导师的交互经验蒸馏到操作和导航专家，然后将他们的决策能力整合到 OmniBrain-0 中。因此，统一是在学习到的决策模型内部发生的，而不仅仅是工具接口层面。我们进一步引入了基于评分标准的递归自我改进（RSI），这是一个数据飞轮，其中元智能体将执行证据转化为精细的评分标准、步骤级提醒和经过验证的轨迹，用于领域专家更新，并在通过 MOPD 重新整合到 OmniBrain-0 之前进行验证。我们在 LIBERO-Pro、LIBERO-Plus、RoboCasa365、RoboTwin 2.0 和 R2R-CE Val-Unseen 以及多个现实世界的操作任务上评估了 OmniBrain-0。OmniBrain-0 结合了强大的跨领域任务性能，并且与闭源导师相比，推理和执行开销显著降低，展示了具身能力高效迁移和整合到紧凑型统一智能体的能力。

articles.title: SEMA-Auto: Sighted and Efficient Multi-Turn Attack with Autonomy
articles.abstract: Existing jailbreak attackers fall into two classes: static planners fix their single- or multi-turn adversarial plans in advance, remaining simple but losing sight of the victim's replies, wasting turns and limiting transferability; interactive generators read each victim reply to generate the next-turn attack but require in-loop evaluators for success signals or hints, incurring substantial costs and inflated performance. Bridging this gap, we propose SEMA-Auto, a sighted and efficient multi-turn attacker with autonomy, interacting with the victim model and terminating the session by itself upon success. To stabilize its behaviors and boost its capabilities, SEMA-Auto is trained in two stages. Synthetic bootstrap tuning installs the notion of attack targets and conforming decisions by fine-tuning the base model with bootstrapped trajectories. Decision-supervised reinforcement learning then optimizes two objectives jointly yet separately, reinforcing the attack with higher jailbreak reward while supervising the decision at each turn against an absolute target. Our method achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) attack success rates (ASR) across multiple datasets, victims, and judges, outperforming all static and interactive baselines, within almost the fewest turns, demonstrating both effectiveness and efficiency. For example, SEMA-Auto performs a $76.0\%$ ASR@1 within an average of $3.0$ turns against DeepSeek-V4-Flash on AdvBench, while the best static baseline is $54.8\%$ with fixed $7$ turns and the best interactive baseline is $43.8\%$ in $3.7$ turns. Against safety-hardened frontier models, GPT-oss-120B, GPT-5.4, Claude-Haiku-4.5, and GPT-6-Astra, our counter-trained attacker achieves an average $59.6\%$ ASR@1 on HarmBench, $13.8\%$ over prior SOTA. Our code is available at: https://github.com/microsoft/SEMA
articles.titleCn: SEMA-Auto：具备自主性的视障高效多轮攻击
articles.abstractCn: 现有的越狱攻击方法可分为两类：静态规划器会提前固定其单轮或多轮的对抗计划，虽然简单但会忽略受害者的回复，浪费回合数并限制可迁移性；交互式生成器会读取每个受害者的回复来生成下一轮的攻击，但需要循环中的评估器来获取成功信号或提示，从而产生巨大成本并导致性能膨胀。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了SEMA-Auto，一种具有自主性和高效性的多轮攻击者，它能与受害者模型交互，并在成功时自行终止会话。为了稳定其行为并提升其能力，SEMA-Auto分两个阶段进行训练。合成引导微调通过使用引导轨迹对基础模型进行微调，来安装攻击目标和合规决策的概念。决策监督强化学习则联合但分别优化两个目标，通过更高的越狱奖励强化攻击，同时监督每一轮的决策以达成绝对目标。我们的方法在多个数据集、受害者和评估器上实现了最先进的（SOTA）攻击成功率（ASR），在几乎最少的回合数内优于所有静态和交互式基线，展现了其有效性和效率。例如，SEMA-Auto在AdvBench上针对DeepSeek-V4-Flash的平均3.0回合内实现了76.0%的ASR@1，而最佳静态基线固定7回合为54.8%，最佳交互式基线在3.7回合内为43.8%。针对安全加固的前沿模型GPT-oss-120B、GPT-5.4、Claude-Haiku-4.5和GPT-6-Astra，我们的对抗训练攻击者在HarmBench上平均实现了59.6%的ASR@1，比之前的SOTA高出13.8%。我们的代码可在以下链接获取：https://github.com/microsoft/SEMA

articles.title: Can JEV Support Clinical Trial Criteria Assessment?
articles.abstract: Clinical trial prescreening requires distinguishing unmet conditions from insufficient evidence in patient records. Given patient records, criterion questions, and predefined answer options, we retrospectively compared JEV, a non-generative decision model returning native option probabilities, with schema-constrained Qwen Flash across 2,048 test patient-condition pairs from TrialGPT and question-answer datasets derived from MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV, all evaluated under strict Zero Data Retention (ZDR) policies to ensure clinical data privacy. Both models assessed conditions individually or in batches sharing the same patient context, with performance measured against reference labels. In batch mode, JEV and Qwen achieved similar macro-F1 scores on TrialGPT (0.652 vs. 0.660) and MIMIC-IV (0.807 vs. 0.814), whereas JEV substantially outperformed Qwen on MIMIC-III (0.768 vs. 0.534; $Δ$ = +0.234, 95% CI: 0.187-0.281). This advantage largely reflected higher recall for conditions labeled as having insufficient information (56.3% vs. 9.9%). Across all three datasets, JEV also had lower observed median job latency (1.18-1.40 vs. 2.80-8.90 s) and 53%-74% lower estimated cost per condition. These findings position JEV as an initial assessment component that provides criterion-level judgments and flags potential information gaps for review. JEV's observed errors in interpreting clinical evidence underscore the need to verify its outputs against patient records before they inform eligibility decisions.
articles.titleCn: JEV能否支持临床试验标准评估？
articles.abstractCn: 临床试验预筛选需要在患者记录中区分未满足的条件与证据不足的情况。基于患者记录、标准问题以及预定义的答案选项，我们回顾性地比较了JEV（一种非生成式决策模型，返回原生选项概率）与模式约束的Qwen Flash，测试样本来自TrialGPT和从MIMIC-III与MIMIC-IV衍生的问题-答案数据集，所有评估均遵循严格的零数据保留（ZDR）政策以确保临床数据隐私。两种模型均以独立或共享相同患者上下文的方式评估条件，其性能通过与参考标签进行对比进行衡量。在批量模式下，JEV和Qwen在TrialGPT（0.652 vs. 0.660）和MIMIC-IV（0.807 vs. 0.814）上实现了相似的宏观F1分数，但在MIMIC-III上，JEV显著优于Qwen（0.768 vs. 0.534；$Δ$ = +0.234，95% CI: 0.187-0.281），这一优势主要体现在对标记为信息不足的条件具有更高的召回率（56.3% vs. 9.9%）。在所有三个数据集中，JEV还表现出更低的观测中位数作业延迟（1.18-1.40 vs. 2.80-8.90秒）和每条件估计成本降低53%-74%。这些发现将JEV定位为初步评估组件，能够提供标准层面的判断并标记潜在的 信息缺失以供审查。JEV在解读临床证据时观察到的错误强调了在将输出用于资格决策前，需要将其与患者记录进行验证的必要性。

articles.title: Quantitative Generalization Bounds for Multi-Layer Transformers: A Few Long Strings can Beat Many Short Ones
articles.abstract: Transformer-based language models exhibit an astonishing capacity to generalize to longer and more difficult problem instances than those seen in training. However, theoretical understanding of this phenomenon still lags behind. Unlike most machine learning models, the generalisation abilities of transformers inherently require considering two axes. On one hand, one must examine in-distribution statistical generalisation, which concerns the ability of a model to broaden a function from training samples to novel samples of the same distribution. On the other hand, given the sequential nature of language data, one must also consider length generalisation, which reflects whether a model trained on inputs of a given length can extrapolate to longer ones. These two notions have mostly been studied separately, leaving open how they interact. In this work, we give a joint treatment of both axes for fixed-precision transformers. We give generalisation guarantees in terms of the parameter sizes of the involved models, as well as the quantization space and the alphabet size that supply the sequences. Finally, we illustrate how the requirements in the sample count and training length trade off. In particular, we find that increasing training length can be exponentially more efficient than increasing the sample size. Experiments support predictions of the theory.

articles.titleCn: 多层Transformer的量化泛化界限：少数长字符串可胜过众多短字符串
articles.abstractCn: 基于Transformer的语言模型展现出令人惊叹的能力，能够泛化到比训练中见过的更长、更难的问题实例。然而，对这种现象的理论理解仍然滞后。与大多数机器学习模型不同，Transformer的泛化能力本质上需要考虑两个维度。一方面，必须检验分布内统计泛化，这涉及模型将一个函数从训练样本扩展到同一分布的新样本的能力。另一方面，鉴于语言数据的序列性质，也必须考虑长度泛化，这反映了在给定长度输入上训练的模型能否外推到更长的输入。这两个概念主要被分别研究，留下了它们如何相互作用的疑问。在这项工作中，我们对固定精度的Transformer的这两个维度进行了联合处理。我们给出了涉及模型的参数大小、量化空间和提供序列的字母表大小方面的泛化保证。最后，我们说明了样本数量和训练长度要求之间的权衡。特别是我们发现，增加训练长度比增加样本数量具有指数级的效率。实验支持了理论的预测。

articles.title: From Self-Confidence to Statistical Accuracy: Scaling Human-in-the-Loop Evaluation with Direct and LLM-Assisted Auditing
articles.abstract: For large language models (LLMs) and multimodal large language models (MLLMs), model-reported self-confidence is often miscalibrated, yet it may still be useful for efficient evaluation. At the same time, LLM-as-a-judge offers a scalable alternative to direct human auditing, but its practical benefit depends on calibration quality and inference cost. This paper develops a unified statistical framework for both evaluation routes under alternative sampling strategies. For direct auditing, confidence-stratified sampling is used to recover population accuracy from partially verified outputs without requiring calibrated confidence. Finite-sample uncertainty is characterized, and the analysis shows how highly uneven confidence strata affect audit efficiency and label allocation. For judge-assisted evaluation, the judge is modeled through sensitivity and false-positive rate, yielding an error-corrected estimator with calibration uncertainty. The two routes are then compared through human-label and total-cost efficiency boundaries. Experiments on MMLU-Pro and MMMU-Pro show that miscalibrated self-confidence can still support statistically valid stratified auditing. Under highly imbalanced confidence distributions, proportional allocation substantially reduces estimation error relative to equal-per-stratum allocation. For judge-assisted evaluation, only a small subset of target--verifier pairs satisfies the idealized human-label efficiency condition, and automated inference costs can further limit potential savings. These findings clarify the statistical and economic conditions under which confidence-guided auditing and automated verification are useful.

articles.titleCn: 从自信到统计准确：通过直接审计和LLM辅助审计扩展人工参与评估的规模
articles.abstractCn: 对于大型语言模型（LLMs）和多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs），模型报告的自我置信度通常存在误校准，但仍然可用于高效的评估。与此同时，将LLM作为评判者提供了一种可扩展的替代直接人工审核的方法，但其实际效益取决于校准质量和推理成本。本文在替代采样策略下，为这两种评估路径开发了一个统一的统计框架。对于直接审核，采用置信度分层采样，从部分验证的输出中恢复群体准确率，而无需校准的置信度。有限样本的不确定性被表征，分析表明高度不均等的置信度分层如何影响审核效率和标签分配。对于评判者辅助评估，通过敏感性和假阳性率对评判者进行建模，得到一个具有校准不确定性的误差校正估计器。然后通过人工标签和总成本效率边界对这两种路径进行比较。在MMLU-Pro和MMMU-Pro上的实验表明，即使自我置信度存在误校准，仍可支持统计有效的分层审核。在高度不平衡的置信度分布下，与等比例分配相比，比例分配显著减少了估计误差。对于评判者辅助评估，只有一小部分目标-验证器对满足理想化的人工标签效率条件，自动推理成本还会进一步限制潜在的节省。这些发现阐明了置信度引导审核和自动验证在何种统计和经济条件下是有用的。

articles.title: MiRL: Error-Targeted Reinforcement Learning for Correcting Terminal Agent Misbehaviors
articles.abstract: Error-targeted learning gives a legible way to improve a model: identify specific weaknesses of the model, train the model to fix these weaknesses, and check whether the weaknesses are fixed. We study how to apply error-targeted learning to terminal agents, which solve long-horizon tasks specified in natural language by interacting with a command shell. Existing error-targeted methods are designed for single-turn tasks, and existing analyses of agent failures are used to evaluate and debug agents rather than to train them. We propose Misbehavior-driven RL (MiRL), which first profiles the errors of a policy to find generalizable misbehaviors: kinds of wrong steps that recur across many environments. MiRL then trains the policy with RL, starting rollouts at the steps where these misbehaviors occur and rewarding a rollout only if it passes the tests and avoids the misbehavior. On Qwen3.5-4B, eight misbehaviors account for 52.1% of wrong steps. After training with MiRL, the policy repeats the measured misbehaviors 43% to 57% less often on average on unseen prefixes. MiRL outperforms TMax-4B on Terminal-Bench Lite (51.8% vs. 47.4%) and matches it on Terminal-Bench 2.1 (21.3% vs. 20.6%), while using 35% of its rollouts. These results show that error-targeted learning can be applied to realistic, long-horizon terminal tasks.

articles.titleCn: MiRL：针对错误目标的强化学习，用于纠正终端智能体不当行为
articles.abstractCn: 错误导向学习提供了一种改进模型的有效方法：识别模型的特定弱点，训练模型修正这些弱点，并检查弱点是否已得到修正。我们研究了如何将错误导向学习应用于终端智能体，这些智能体通过与命令行交互来解决自然语言指定的长时程任务。现有的错误导向方法是为单轮任务设计的，而现有的智能体失效分析主要用于评估和调试智能体，而非用于训练它们。我们提出了基于错误行为的强化学习（MiRL），该方法首先分析策略的错误，以发现可推广的错误行为：在许多环境中反复出现的错误步骤类型。然后，MiRL使用强化学习训练策略，从这些错误行为发生的步骤开始执行，并且只有当执行过程通过测试并避免错误行为时才给予奖励。在Qwen3.5-4B上，八个错误行为占错误步骤的52.1%。经过MiRL的训练后，策略在未见过的前缀上重复测量到的错误行为频率平均降低了43%到57%。MiRL在Terminal-Bench Lite上的表现优于TMax-4B（51.8% vs. 47.4%），并在Terminal-Bench 2.1上与TMax-4B持平（21.3% vs. 20.6%），同时仅使用了35%的执行次数。这些结果表明，错误导向学习可以应用于现实中的长时程终端任务。

articles.title: Not One Belief: Answer Payloads, Persistence, and Dissociated Confidence Signals in Conversational Question Answering
articles.abstract: Conversational QA systems should fix errors when users push back and signal which answers to trust. We split each follow-up into its speech act (re-ask, agree, or challenge) and its payload (an answer string, correct or not), and measure four confidence signals on the same transcripts: verbalized confidence, length-normalized likelihood, a frozen hidden-state probe, and P(True). Answers change when the user supplies an answer string and almost never under the speech act alone: in every retained full-size cell, the correct answer converts at least four times as many wrong answers as re-asking or agreement. The four signals disagree. On Qwen2.5-7B the frozen probe rises with answer persistence rather than truth; this holds on held-out questions, with Llama-3-8B (cleaned answers) as support, but not on four other models. Among 81 Qwen2.5-7B errors that survive one re-ask, re-asking, a fresh chat, or abstain repair almost none, while a gold answer repairs 75-95%. In two preregistered replications, every repair rate without an answer string stays below 0.15; a larger post-hoc rerun excludes 0.15 except for the empty elicit. With BM25 TriviaQA evidence, sentences that contain the answer repair 67-76% of persistent errors versus at most 12% when they do not. An end-to-end contain-gate cuts harm on TriviaQA, but a deployable gate that does not know the gold answer repairs few errors.
articles.titleCn: 非单一信念：对话式问答中的响应负载、持久性和分离式置信信号
articles.abstractCn: 对话式问答系统应在用户提出质疑时修正错误，并标示哪些答案值得信赖。我们将每个后续问题分解为其言语行为（重新提问、同意或质疑）及其有效载荷（正确或错误的答案字符串），并在同一文本记录上测量四种置信度信号：口头表达的置信度、长度归一化的似然度、冻结的隐藏状态探测以及P(True)。当用户提供答案字符串时，答案会发生变化，而单独基于言语行为几乎不会发生变化：在每个保留的全尺寸单元中，正确答案修正的错误数量至少是重新提问或同意的四倍。这四种信号存在分歧。在Qwen2.5-7B上，冻结的探测随着答案的持续存在而上升，而非真实性；这一现象在保留问题中成立，以Llama-3-8B（清理后的答案）作为支持，但在其他四个模型上不成立。在81个Qwen2.5-7B错误中，即使经过一次重新提问、一次全新对话或放弃修复，重新提问修复的错误几乎为零，而黄金答案修复了75-95%。在两项预先注册的重复实验中，没有答案字符串的修复率始终保持在0.15以下；一次更大的事后重跑排除了0.15，除了空白的提取。使用BM25 TriviaQA证据时，包含答案的句子修复了67-76%的持续错误，而不包含答案时最多仅修复12%。端到端的包含门在TriviaQA上减少了危害，但一个不知道黄金答案的可部署门修复的错误很少。

articles.title: Adapting LLM-SC to Living Sacred Heritage: Domain-Specific Extraction, Semantic Networks and Human Evaluation on Pashupatinath Temple Reviews
articles.abstract: Large language model (LLM) pipelines can turn visitor reviews into structured data, but generic schemes may miss rituals, sacred spaces, cultural restrictions and emotionally mixed experiences at living sacred heritage sites. We adapted the LLM-Social Computing (LLM-SC) framework to Pashupatinath Temple, Nepal, by specifying a 12-type entity taxonomy (four original LLM-SC types plus eight sacred-heritage types), four relation types and nine aspect-sentiment dimensions in a GPT-4o extraction prompt, which was applied to a fixed random sample of 2,500 English-language Tripadvisor reviews from a processed corpus of 3,939. The exports contain 11,286 entity, 6,232 aspect-sentiment and 5,590 relation records, covering 2,485, 2,487 and 2,433 reviews, respectively; the eight added sacred-heritage types account for 64.8% of entity records. Against an adjudicated two-annotator reference for 200 reviews, exact normalized surface-and-type matching gave provisional entity scores of 41.0% precision, 21.8% recall and 28.4% micro-F1. Aspect-presence F1 was 53.6% and end-to-end aspect-plus-polarity F1 was 42.6%. Human adjudication supported 153 of 194 first-listed relation candidates (one per review; 78.9%), a candidate-level rate that does not estimate relation recall or whole-graph precision. The contribution is a culturally grounded, domain-specific adaptation with component-wise human evaluation and explicit reproducibility and generalization limitations.
articles.titleCn: 将LLM-SC应用于生活神圣遗产：特定领域的提取、语义网络和帕舒帕蒂纳特寺庙评论中的人类评估
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）流程可以将游客评论转化为结构化数据，但通用方案可能会遗漏生活圣地的仪式、神圣空间、文化限制和情感复杂的体验。我们通过在GPT-4o提取提示中指定12类实体分类法（四个原始LLM-SC类型加上八个圣遗产类型）、四种关系类型和九个方面-情感维度，将LLM-社交计算（LLM-SC）框架应用于尼泊尔帕斯普提纳特寺庙。该框架应用于从3,939个处理过的语料库中抽取的2,500条英语语言Tripadvisor评论的固定随机样本。导出的数据包含11,286条实体记录、6,232条方面-情感记录和5,590条关系记录，分别涵盖2,485、2,487和2,433条评论；新增的八个圣遗产类型占实体记录的64.8%。针对200条评论的两位标注员判定的参考标准，精确匹配法给出了41.0%的精确率、21.8%的召回率和28.4%的微观F1分数。方面存在F1为53.6%，端到端方面加极性F1为42.6%。人工判定支持了194条评论中每条评论列出的194个关系候选中的153个（78.9%），但候选级比率无法评估关系召回率或全图精确率。这项贡献是基于文化背景的特定领域适应性调整，包含组件级人工评估，并明确说明了可重复性和泛化限制。

articles.title: Evaluating DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017 for loss of control and harmful manipulation risks
articles.abstract: As frontier language models grow increasingly capable and autonomous, independent third-party evaluations are critical for characterizing their systemic safety risks. While closed-source releases are routinely accompanied by comprehensive system cards, open-weight models receive less scrutiny regarding frontier risks. To address this gap, we present an independent safety evaluation of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017, the latest version of V4.1 Flash that departs from V4 with a new architecture, scaled-up training, and strong agentic capabilities. Drawing on the EU General-Purpose AI Code of Practice, we evaluate the model across 34 benchmarks, including 5 in-house suites, spanning evaluation integrity, loss of control, and harmful manipulation. Conforming to the AEF-1 standard, we compare V4.1 Flash-1017 against V4.1 Flash, earlier DeepSeek V4 models, and leading closed-source systems (GPT-6 Astra, GPT-5.6 Sol, and Gemini 3.8 Flash). Overall, V4.1 Flash-1017 shows substantial safety improvements over the V4 generation and approaches or matches leading closed-source baselines on several dimensions, while still exhibiting notable behaviors that warrant continued attention. Building on our findings, we highlight three key observations and recommendations. First, because safety can shift and even regress across minor updates, developers should integrate safety evaluation into incremental releases. Second, as final-turn outputs and end-state checks alone cannot reliably detect loss-of-control behaviors, deployments require process-level observability across both reasoning traces and action logs. Third, because public benchmarks elicit strong evaluation awareness and face data contamination risks, developing private benchmarks is essential for trustworthy frontier evaluation.
articles.titleCn: 评估DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017在失控和有害操控风险方面的表现
articles.abstractCn: 随着前沿语言模型日益增强和自主，独立的第三方评估对于表征其系统性安全风险至关重要。虽然闭源发布通常会附带全面的系统说明卡，但开源权重模型在前沿风险方面受到的关注较少。为填补这一空白，我们针对DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017进行了独立安全评估，这是V4.1 Flash的最新版本，与V4版本不同，它采用了新的架构、扩大了训练规模，并具备强大的自主能力。基于欧盟通用人工智能实践准则，我们在34个基准测试中评估了该模型，包括5个内部套件，涵盖评估完整性、失控风险和有害操控。遵循AEF-1标准，我们将V4.1 Flash-1017与V4.1 Flash、早期的DeepSeek V4模型以及领先的闭源系统（GPT-6 Astra、GPT-5.6 Sol和Gemini 3.8 Flash）进行了比较。总体而言，V4.1 Flash-1017在安全性方面相较于V4系列有显著提升，并在多个维度上接近或达到了领先的闭源基线，但仍然表现出值得持续关注的显著行为。基于我们的发现，我们强调了三点关键观察和建议。首先，由于安全性可能随着小版本更新而变化甚至倒退，开发者应将安全评估整合到增量发布中。其次，由于仅依赖最终回合输出和最终状态检查无法可靠地检测失控行为，部署需要跨推理轨迹和行动日志的流程级可观测性。第三，由于公共基准测试会引发强烈的评估意识并面临数据污染风险，开发私有基准测试对于可信的前沿评估至关重要。

articles.title: MedJev: Evaluating Zero-Shot System-One Decision Making in Medicine
articles.abstract: System One decision models such as Jev answer structured questions in a single forward pass without generating text, offering fast and computationally efficient clinical decision support. We evaluate MedJev, an open System One model that runs locally on a laptop, across ten medical benchmarks spanning medical knowledge, diagnosis, and patient level prediction using MIMIC IV and MIMIC IV ED. We compare MedJev against zero shot LLM baselines, published GPT results, and supervised models. MedJev achieves accuracies of 72.5 percent on MedQA, 75.4 percent on USMLE, and 80.1 percent on NEJM, approaching published GPT 4 performance while maintaining well calibrated confidence estimates (ECE 0.028 to 0.063). On patient level tasks, MedJev achieves an AUROC of 0.926 for In Hospital Mortality, exceeding XGBoost (0.902), but underperforms supervised models on operational outcomes such as ED Triage Admission (0.745 vs. 0.809). Patient level predictions also exhibit substantial miscalibration (In Hospital Mortality ECE 0.286). We introduce a lightweight, two parameter recalibration method that adapts predictions to local patient populations using 50 to 200 labeled examples, reducing ECE to 0.007. Our findings establish open System One models as a promising zero shot baseline for medical AI, combining competitive predictive performance with low computational cost and efficient local calibration. We release our code and evaluation harness to support future research.
articles.titleCn: MedJev：评估医学中零样本系统一的决策制定
articles.abstractCn: 系统一决策模型（如Jev）能够在单次正向传递中回答结构化问题，无需生成文本，从而提供快速且计算效率高的临床决策支持。我们评估了MedJev，一个可在笔记本电脑本地运行的开放系统一模型，在涵盖医学知识、诊断和患者水平预测的十个医学基准上使用MIMIC IV和MIMIC IV ED进行评估。我们将MedJev与零样本LLM基线、已发表的GPT结果和监督模型进行比较。MedJev在MedQA上达到72.5%的准确率，在USMLE上达到75.4%，在NEJM上达到80.1%，接近已发表的GPT 4性能，同时保持良好的置信度估计（ECE 0.028至0.063）。在患者水平任务中，MedJev对于住院死亡率达到0.926的AUROC，超过XGBoost（0.902），但在急诊分诊入院等运营结果上表现不佳（0.745 vs. 0.809）。患者水平预测也表现出显著的误校准（住院死亡率ECE 0.286）。我们引入了一种轻量级、两参数的重新校准方法，使用50至200个标记示例来调整预测以适应本地患者群体，将ECE降低至0.007。我们的研究确立了开放系统一模型作为医学AI的零样本基线，结合了具有竞争力的预测性能、低计算成本和高效的本地校准。我们发布了我们的代码和评估工具以支持未来的研究。

articles.title: Improving JEV Entailment Reranking with Span Readouts and Selective Adaptation
articles.abstract: JEV decision models pair a language model backbone with a lightweight scoring head to select among natural-language options. Direct selection compares candidate answers within one request, whereas entailment reranking evaluates each candidate in a separate natural language inference (NLI) request over fixed relation options. We examine whether the readout and adaptation choices used for direct selection remain effective for cross-request reranking. We combine a mean-span readout with selective backbone adaptation. Mean-span pooling replaces the option-ending pointer with an average of the contextualized states inside each NLI option, without adding head parameters. Selective adaptation retains low-rank updates in attention and gated DeltaNet projections while removing feed-forward adapters. On MC11, which averages accuracy over eleven reranking configurations from seven sources, selective adaptation improves NeoHorse-1-4B accuracy over the all-module baseline while cutting trainable parameters by more than half, and mean-span pooling yields further consistent gains at the same parameter count.
articles.titleCn: 使用跨度读取和选择性适应改进JEV蕴涵重新排序
articles.abstractCn: JEV决策模型将语言模型主干与轻量级评分头相结合，用于从自然语言选项中进行选择。直接选择在单个请求内比较候选答案，而蕴涵重排序则在固定的关系选项上针对每个候选答案进行单独的自然语言推理（NLI）请求进行评估。我们考察了用于直接选择的读出和自适应选择是否对跨请求重排序仍然有效。我们将平均跨度读出与选择性主干自适应相结合。平均跨度池化用每个NLI选项内部上下文状态的平均值替换选项结束指针，而无需添加头参数。选择性自适应保留注意力和门控DeltaNet投影中的低秩更新，同时移除前馈适配器。在MC11上，该模型平均了来自七个来源的十一种重排序配置的准确率，选择性自适应在所有模块基线的基础上提高了NeoHorse-1-4B的准确率，同时将可训练参数减少了一半以上，而平均跨度池化在相同的参数数量下带来了进一步的稳定提升。

articles.title: Offline Language-Based Support System for Tactical Decision-Making in Air Combat Operations
articles.abstract: An offline language-based support tool is presented to assist pilot training and tactical decision-making in air combat operations. The system, named MATE (Mission Assistant for Training and Evaluation), applies retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to answer natural language questions using content extracted from doctrinal and tactical manuals. Built entirely with open-source components, it performs text preprocessing, embedding generation, semantic search, and language generation locally, ensuring full offline functionality. The tool was evaluated by three Brazilian Air Force fighter pilots, who rated the answers produced with three open-weight language models (Llama 3.1 8B, Qwen 2.5 14B, and Mistral NeMo 12B) to five tactical questions derived from a publicly available air combat manual. Average ratings ranged from 4.00 to 4.40 on a five-point scale, with Mistral NeMo 12B obtaining the highest score, and the pilots rated the response time of the tool as fully adequate compared to manual search. The relevance of the retrieved content was identified as the main point for improvement. Potential applications are discussed in onboard mission systems, flight simulators, and training environments.
