articles.titleCn: 在没有正式答案的情况下可训练的边界保持：一项关于证据充分性判断中奖励训练的受控敲入研究
articles.abstractCn: 推理调优和奖励训练的模型通常被认为更可靠，因为它们推理时间更长或接收正确性信号。我们在证据充分性判断中测试了这一点：判断现有信息是否真正支持一个因果关系主张，这是一个没有可判定正确性奖励的领域。使用预先注册的、相同基础、受控敲入设计，我们比较了一种边界保持配方（SFT然后GRPO）与其自身基线、打乱配对的安慰剂，以及在一个无评估邀请的行动压力协议下的一般推理模型。所有承重结果由两个对臂标签进行盲目的模型评分会话进行评分；自动评分者仅被触发。训练过的臂将自发正确拒绝从25%提高到100%（每臂40个；Wilson 95% CI下限为91.2%，与基线区间[14.2%, 40.2%]不重叠），而打乱的安慰剂崩溃（5%自发 / 7.5%邀请正确；91.1%错误拒绝）。这种效应是边界特定的，而不是全面拒绝：在281个规范声明上的自动错误拒绝为1.1%（Wilson上限为3.09%），而针对18项臂-(c)复查（3个被标记加15个被接受）在两个会话中分别产生0/18和1/18的错误拒绝。分离是主要结果：最终边界保持是可训练的，无需推理时验证器，而在H3测试中观察到的主动数字/计算检查接近于零；SFT饱和使得GRPO增量无法单独识别。预先注册的机制裁决倾向于最终行动状态的奖励内化（H2，最佳支持，未证实）。范围是一个受控的14B同家族研究：我们不声称证明、跨家族普遍性或独立人类专家验证；评分会话是模型会话，不是人类评审者。

articles.title: DTCA: Denoising Token Credit Assignment for Reinforcement Learning in Diffusion Language Models
articles.abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) generate text through iterative denoising, enabling bidirectional context modeling and parallel token refinement. Recent studies have applied reinforcement learning (RL) to DLMs and improved their reasoning performance. However, the iterative denoising process makes credit assignment more challenging, as final outcome rewards provide limited information about how different tokens contribute to the final output. In this paper, we propose Denoising Token Credit Assignment (DTCA), a framework for token-level credit assignment in reinforcement learning for diffusion language models. DTCA estimates token contributions by measuring the improvement in prediction confidence of remaining masked positions after token commitment and groups these signals according to part-of-speech (POS) categories. These contribution weights are used to select informative denoising timesteps and assign token-level learning signals during RL training. DTCA further calibrates these learning signals according to token-level entropy changes induced by policy updates. Experiments on LLaDA-8B-Instruct show that DTCA consistently improves mathematical reasoning performance across different generation budgets, with gains of up to 9.0 points on MATH500 and 5.3 points on GSM8K over the base model.
articles.titleCn: DTCA：扩散语言模型强化学习中的去噪标记信用分配
articles.abstractCn: 扩散语言模型（DLMs）通过迭代去噪生成文本，支持双向上下文建模和并行标记优化。近期研究将强化学习（RL）应用于DLMs并提升了其推理性能。然而，迭代去噪过程使信用分配更具挑战性，因为最终结果的奖励提供了有限的信息，难以了解不同标记对最终输出的贡献程度。在本文中，我们提出了去噪标记信用分配（DTCA）框架，用于扩散语言模型在强化学习中的标记级信用分配。DTCA通过测量标记确定后剩余遮盖位置预测置信度的提升来估计标记贡献，并根据词性（POS）类别对这些信号进行分组。这些贡献权重用于选择信息量大的去噪时间步长，并在RL训练中分配标记级学习信号。DTCA进一步根据策略更新引起的标记级熵变化对这些学习信号进行校准。在LLaDA-8B-Instruct上的实验表明，DTCA在不同生成预算下始终提升数学推理性能，相较于基础模型，在MATH500上提升了高达9.0分，在GSM8K上提升了5.3分。

articles.title: Lost in Translation: Investigating Systematic Discrepancies between Parallel English and Chinese Names of American Chinese Restaurants
articles.abstract: Given that the Chinese are one of the oldest ethnic groups to immigrate to the US, their cuisine have become central to the US dining scene and an interesting avenue to study how Chinese immigrants have culturally adapted into American life. In that regard, previous research has focused on analyzing the English names that Chinese restaurants adopt, e.g., finding the use of familiar and typical words. To investigate how Chinese immigrants have culturally integrated in the US depending on social, geographic and demographic contexts, we investigate in this work the under-explored relationship between the Chinese and English names of American Chinese restaurants. Specifically, we conduct a study on 3,172 Chinese restaurants (10% of the total on Google Maps) sampled across the US. We present 8-dimension name frames to capture the underlying meanings behind names and create the NameFrames dataset containing 884 annotated parallel Chinese/English names. We also built an NLP pipeline to analyze the semantic discrepancies between names with both frame-based and embedding-based distance metrics. Our frame analysis shows that English names more often emphasize Location and Specialty, while Chinese names more often emphasize Positivity and Ambiance. Furthermore, we observe that for Chinese restaurants located in urban areas, those in counties with a higher concentration of Chinese population, or those that are relatively new, the discrepancies between the English and Chinese names are noticeably larger. Finally, interviews with 10 Chinese restaurant owners reveal additional interesting insights regarding naming conventions.
articles.titleCn: 《翻译之失：探究美式中餐馆英文名称与中文名称之间的系统性差异》
articles.abstractCn: 鉴于中国人是美国最早移民的民族之一，他们的美食已成为美国餐饮场景的核心，并成为研究中国移民如何文化适应美国生活的一个有趣途径。在这方面，以往的研究侧重于分析中国餐馆采用的英文名称，例如寻找熟悉和典型的词汇使用。为了调查中国移民在美国根据社会、地理和人口背景的文化融合情况，我们在本研究中调查了美国中餐馆中中英文名称之间尚未充分探索的关系。具体而言，我们对美国3,172家中国餐馆（谷歌地图上总量的10%）进行了抽样研究。我们提出了一个包含8个维度的名称框架来捕捉名称背后的深层含义，并创建了包含884个标注的中英文名称对的NameFrames数据集。我们还构建了一个自然语言处理流程，通过基于框架和基于嵌入的距离度量来分析名称之间的语义差异。我们的框架分析表明，英文名称更常强调地点和特色，而中文名称更常强调积极性和氛围。此外，我们观察到，位于城市地区、人口密度较高的县或相对较新的中国餐馆，其英文名称和中文名称之间的差异更为显著。最后，对10位中国餐馆老板的访谈揭示了关于命名惯例的更多有趣见解。

articles.title: High Scores, Hidden Failures: Evaluating Codebook-Based LLM Content Analysis
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for codebook-based content analysis in computational social science, where codebooks translate theoretical concepts into labeling schemes. While prior work reports strong predictive performance, it remains unclear whether these systems produce reliable and robust text annotations. We conduct a large-scale empirical failure-mode analysis of LLM-based coding pipelines across four datasets and five models by systematically evaluating their stability, robustness, and conceptual validity under controlled perturbations, domain shifts, and optimization procedures. We uncover multiple failure modes that are largely invisible under standard metrics, showing that high aggregate scores frequently coexist with severe label-level disparities, instability across runs, domain sensitivity, and shifts in label interpretation. Importantly, these failure modes persist under widely used optimization strategies and remain largely invisible under standard metrics such as accuracy and micro-F1. Our results demonstrate that current LLM-based coding pipelines cannot be treated as stable measurement tools without targeted validation beyond aggregate performance.
articles.titleCn: 高分，隐藏的失败：评估基于代码簿的大型语言模型内容分析
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在计算社会科学中的基于代码簿的内容分析中应用日益广泛，其中代码簿将理论概念转化为标签方案。尽管已有研究报道了强大的预测性能，但这些系统是否能够产生可靠且稳健的文本标注仍不明确。我们通过对四个数据集和五种模型进行的基于LLM的编码流程的大规模实证失效模式分析，系统地评估了它们在受控扰动、领域转变和优化程序下的稳定性、鲁棒性和概念有效性。我们发现多种在标准指标下难以察觉的失效模式，表明高综合评分常常与严重的标签级差异、运行间的不稳定性、领域敏感性和标签解释的偏移共存。重要的是，这些失效模式在广泛使用的优化策略下仍然存在，并且在准确率和微观F1等标准指标下基本难以察觉。我们的结果表明，当前的基于LLM的编码流程在综合性能之外，若未经针对性的验证，不能被视为稳定的测量工具。

articles.title: Do Language Models Understand Igbo Culture? Beyond Multiple Choice
articles.abstract: The value of language models for any community depends on whether a model actually understands the culture of the people it intends to serve. We use the Igbo language as a case study. Existing benchmarks test translated Western ideas, lacking depth. To address this, we introduce CAB-Igbo, a benchmark developed from indigenous cultural sources and verified by native speakers across six domains. We evaluated diverse models under varying conditions, incorporating regional personas. Performance was assessed using multiple-choice accuracy and human evaluations across Epistemic Fidelity, Representational Richness, Linguistic Quality, and Pragmatic Proficiency. Results reveal a stark dissociation between language fluency and cultural knowledge. Through statistical testing, we show that for most models, the severe lack of Epistemic Fidelity and Representational Richness is already present in English and does not significantly worsen when switching to Igbo. Instead, native language prompting mainly degrades Linguistic Quality and Pragmatic Proficiency. Gemini 2.0 Flash is the only model whose cultural knowledge scores improve under Igbo prompting. We find that current models struggle to demonstrate the knowledge needed for true alignment with Igbo, and multiple-choice formats allow pattern-matching to appear as understanding. Furthermore, automated judges agree with humans on linguistic quality but fail on epistemic fidelity. Ultimately, cultural evaluation must be built from community knowledge, establishing human evaluation as the gold standard to prevent misrepresenting low-resource communities globally.
articles.comment: 20 pages, 7 figures, 14 tables. v2: added two missing authors
articles.titleCn: 语言模型理解伊博文化吗？超越选择题
articles.abstractCn: 任何社区中语言模型的价值取决于该模型是否真正理解其服务对象的文化。我们以伊博语为例进行研究。现有的基准测试的是翻译过来的西方思想，缺乏深度。为此，我们引入了CAB-Igbo，这是一个基于本土文化资源开发的基准，并经过六领域母语者的验证。我们在不同条件下评估了多种模型，并融入了地域性角色。性能评估采用多项选择准确率和人类评估，涵盖认知忠实度、代表性丰富度、语言质量和语用能力。结果表明，语言流利度与文化知识之间存在明显的脱节。通过统计测试，我们发现对于大多数模型，认知忠实度和代表性丰富度的严重缺乏在英语中已经存在，并且在切换到伊博语时并没有显著恶化。相反，母语提示主要降低了语言质量和语用能力。Gemini 2.0 Flash是唯一一个在伊博语提示下文化知识得分提升的模型。我们发现当前模型难以展现与伊博语真正对齐所需的知识，而多项选择格式使模式匹配看起来像是理解。此外，自动评判者在与人类评判者对语言质量达成一致时，却在认知忠实度上表现不佳。最终，文化评估必须基于社区知识，确立人类评估为黄金标准，以防止全球低资源社区被错误呈现。

articles.title: CalibraRL: Confidence-Calibrated Reinforcement Learning for Mitigating Hallucinations in RAG
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often produce plausible but incorrect answers, motivating reinforcement learning methods that reward correct answers, penalize incorrect answers, and allow abstention. However, fixed outcome-based rewards do not distinguish incorrect responses with different confidence levels or account for differences in answering reliability across queries. Consequently, such rewards may inadequately penalize overconfident errors and fail to discourage unnecessary abstention. We propose CalibraRL, a reinforcement learning framework that incorporates response confidence and query-level answering evidence into reward design. For non-abstaining responses, CalibraRL combines correctness-based utility with a Brier-based penalty that encourages agreement between confidence and correctness. For abstentions, it estimates conditional answering reliability using a Beta posterior derived from the correctness of non-abstaining responses within each sampled group. The abstention reward increases with the posterior probability that the model's accuracy on non-abstaining responses is below a predefined threshold. CalibraRL reuses training rollouts without requiring additional annotations indicating whether the model knows the answer to each question. Experiments on three QA datasets demonstrate that CalibraRL improves answer precision and reduces hallucinations compared with strong baselines. Further analysis shows that CalibraRL reduces mean expected calibration error (ECE) by 30.8\% across two backbone models and three datasets, highlighting its potential to improve the reliability of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) in web search.
articles.titleCn: CalibraRL：用于减轻RAG中幻觉的置信度校准强化学习
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）常常生成看似合理但错误的答案，这促使了强化学习方法的发展，这些方法奖励正确答案、惩罚错误答案，并允许不回答。然而，固定的基于结果奖励无法区分不同置信度水平的错误回答，也无法考虑不同查询间回答可靠性的差异。因此，这种奖励可能无法充分惩罚过度自信的错误，也无法有效阻止不必要的拒绝回答。我们提出了CalibraRL，一个将回答置信度和查询级回答证据纳入奖励设计的强化学习框架。对于非拒绝回答，CalibraRL结合基于正确性的效用与基于布里尔（Brier）的惩罚，鼓励置信度与正确性之间的一致性。对于拒绝回答，它使用从每个采样组内非拒绝回答的正确性推导出的Beta后验分布来估计条件回答可靠性。拒绝回答的奖励随着模型非拒绝回答准确率低于预设阈值的后验概率的增加而增加。CalibraRL重用训练回放，无需额外的标注来指示模型是否知道每个问题的答案。在三个问答数据集上的实验表明，与强基线相比，CalibraRL提高了回答精度并减少了幻觉。进一步分析显示，CalibraRL在两个主干模型和三个数据集上平均预期校准误差（ECE）降低了30.8%，突显了其提高网络搜索中检索增强生成（RAG）可靠性的潜力。

articles.title: Quality over Quantity: Rethinking Data and Model Assumptions for Bengali Coreference Resolution
articles.abstract: Multilingual transformer models are often assumed to generalise across languages, but their effectiveness for coreference resolution in low-resource settings remains unverified. We investigate this gap in Bengali, a language with over 250 million speakers but limited annotated coreference resources. We evaluate transformer-based pre-trained encoders under multiple settings, including zero-shot, fine-tuning, data augmentation, and cross-lingual transfer. Our results challenge several common assumptions about model generalisation and data efficiency in low-resource NLP. We demonstrate that a small amount of high-quality annotated data significantly outperforms larger mixed-quality datasets (p < 0.01). We find that data augmentation, particularly back-translation, does not improve performance and can degrade results in coreference resolution. Cross-lingual transfer is also inconsistent: transfer from a distant language like English reduces performance, and transfer from the related language Hindi provides no consistent benefit across models. Several widely used multilingual models exhibit collapsed embedding spaces, rendering them unsuitable for similarity-based clustering tasks. These findings highlight the importance of annotation quality over data quantity and provide empirical guidance for developing coreference resolution systems in low-resource languages.
articles.comment: Accepted at KONVENS 2026, Hamburg, Germany. 11 pages, 1 figure, 5 tables. Code: https://github.com/zenith19/bengali-coref-low-resource
articles.titleCn: 注重质量而非数量：重新思考孟加拉语共指消解中的数据和模型假设
articles.abstractCn: 多语言Transformer模型通常被认为能够跨语言泛化，但它们在低资源环境下的核心指代消解效果尚未得到验证。我们研究了孟加拉语这一拥有超过2.5亿人口但核心指代标注资源有限的语言中的这一差距。我们在多种设置下评估了基于Transformer的预训练编码器，包括零样本学习、微调、数据增强和跨语言迁移。我们的结果挑战了低资源自然语言处理中关于模型泛化和数据效率的若干普遍假设。我们证明，少量高质量的标注数据显著优于更大规模的混合质量数据集（p < 0.01）。我们发现数据增强（尤其是回译）并未提升性能，反而可能降低核心指代消解结果。跨语言迁移效果也不稳定：从英语等远缘语言迁移会降低性能，而从相关语言印地语迁移对模型没有一致性的提升效果。几种广泛使用的多语言模型表现出嵌入空间坍塌现象，使其不适合基于相似性的聚类任务。这些发现强调了标注质量胜于数据量的重要性，并为开发低资源语言的核心指代消解系统提供了实证指导。

articles.title: Rethinking Evaluation for Principled Generalization Using a Kripkean Challenge to Meaning as Use
articles.abstract: Large language models operationalize an intuitive, view of meaning as use. We argue that it faces a rule-following challenge. Using Kripke's interpretation of Wittgenstein, we argue that finite histories of use do not determine a unique rule for future extension. This reframes the debate about OOD generalization but also about NLP evaluation; benchmarks that measure performance on fixed use cases or local robustness, we argue, do not by themselves establish semantic competence. To evaluate whether models preserve rules and concepts under principled domain extension, we propose to evaluate two capacities, central to this ability: abstraction and recursion; and we offer an experimental paradigm for testing both.
articles.titleCn: 以克里普克式的挑战意义为使用来重新思考原则性泛化的评估
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型将意义视为使用的直观理解进行操作化。我们认为它面临着一个遵循规则的挑战。通过使用克里普克对维特根斯坦的解释，我们论证有限的使用历史并不能唯一确定未来的扩展规则。这重新定义了关于泛化外推（OOD generalization）的辩论，同时也关于自然语言处理（NLP）评估；我们主张，那些测量在固定用例或局部鲁棒性上表现的评价基准本身并不能确立语义能力。为了评估模型在原则性领域扩展下是否保留规则和概念，我们提出评估两种核心能力：抽象和递归；并提供了测试这两种能力的实验范式。

articles.title: Useful Diversity or Hallucinated Variety? Persona-Conditioned Synthetic Query Generation for E-Commerce Search
articles.abstract: Synthetic supervision can bootstrap semantic parsers in new search domains, but prompt-induced diversity is useful only when generations are faithful to the structured intent. We explore this for cold-start e-commerce search: 118,098 synthetic pairs produced by 6 LLMs with 9 persona-conditioned prompt families on a 47-field UK automotive schema, against 1,214 human-annotated and 15,304 production queries. We show that the IPIP personality bundle improves parser F1 in all four matched contrasts (Holm-corrected $p<.001$), and all three bundles have a positive main effect over the complete $2^3$ grid. Syntax conditioning is the axis that moves generations towards real traffic. It also induces lexical diversity. Alignment sKL, the divergence between von Mises-Fisher distributions fitted to synthetic and human-annotated queries, is an unlabelled proxy for parser F1 ($ρ=-0.917$ against human queries written for simulated shopper scenarios, lower is closer). An LLM committee, checked against a blinded author pass, triages the 927 queries missed by every parser and labels 37% as hallucinated. Dropped constraints dominate. The four syntax-bearing families have the largest hallucinated shares, 38 to 42%, while IPIP alone has the lowest at 28%.
articles.comment: Accepted at IJCNLP-AACL 2026 (Findings). 20 pages, 2 figures, 16 tables
articles.titleCn: 实用多样性还是幻觉式变化？面向电子商务搜索的人格条件合成查询生成
articles.abstractCn: 合成监督可以在新的搜索域中引导语义解析器，但提示诱导的多样性只有在生成结果忠实于结构化意图时才有用。我们针对冷启动电商搜索进行了探索：使用6种大型语言模型（LLM）在47字段英国汽车架构上生成118,098对合成数据，包含9种角色条件提示家族，并与1,214个人工标注和15,304个生产查询进行对比。结果表明，IPIP人格包在所有四组匹配对比中（Holm校正后p<.001）均提高了解析器的F1值，且所有三种人格包在完整的2^3网格上均具有正向主效应。句法条件是使生成结果趋向真实流量的关键轴，同时也诱导了词汇多样性。对齐sKL，即合成查询和人工标注查询的冯米塞斯-富勒分布拟合之间的差异，是解析器F1的无标签代理指标（ρ=-0.917，对模拟购物场景下的人工查询，数值越低越接近）。一个经过盲法作者验证的LLM委员会筛选出每个解析器遗漏的927个查询，并将其中37%标记为幻觉。被删除的约束条件占主导地位。包含句法的四个家族具有最高的幻觉比例，为38%至42%，而仅使用IPIP的人格包比例最低，为28%。

articles.title: RAGing Against Misogyny: Improving Implicit Misogyny Explanations
articles.abstract: Implicit misogyny often requires background knowledge to be understood. To address this challenge, we propose a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework for detecting and explaining implicit misogyny in English and Italian, leveraging encyclopedic, slang and feminist knowledge sources. Using the ImplicIT-Mis and SBIC+ datasets, we evaluate the contribution of each knowledge source to detection and explanation quality, investigating also whether RAG addresses known LLM failure modes in implicit misogyny. Results show that RAG improves recall on ImplicIT-Mis, but does not improve detection performance on SBIC+. However, human evaluation shows that RAG-based explanations are preferred over no-RAG explanations in both languages. Feminist literature emerges as the most consistently useful source for detection and explanation.
articles.titleCn: 对抗厌女：改进隐性厌女解释
articles.abstractCn: 隐性性别歧视往往需要背景知识才能被理解。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种检索增强生成（RAG）框架，用于检测和解释英语和意大利语中的隐性性别歧视，该框架利用百科、俚语和女权主义知识资源。使用ImplicIT-Mis和SBIC+数据集，我们评估了每个知识资源对检测和解释质量贡献，并调查了RAG是否解决了已知的大型语言模型在隐性性别歧视中的失效模式。结果显示，RAG提高了ImplicIT-Mis的召回率，但在SBIC+上并未提升检测性能。然而，人工评估表明，在两种语言中，基于RAG的解释均优于非RAG解释。女权主义文献成为检测和解释中最一致有效的知识来源。

articles.title: Ask Before You Answer: A Question-Driven Evidence Reasoning Architecture (QERA) for In-Context Learning
articles.abstract: AI assistants are increasingly asked to reason over a user's own web traces: group chats, community threads, activity logs and revision histories. On CL-bench Life, a benchmark of such real-life context learning, frontier LLMs solve fewer than one task in five. We find that the request is not the specification: over 80% of the benchmark's rubrics share less than 60% of their content words with the final request, as for a rule set two turns earlier or every record that meets the user's criterion, and LLMs answering directly pass only 67% of these implicit rubrics against 81% of the others. We propose QERA, a Question-driven Evidence Reasoning Architecture that asks before it answers. QERA first turns the request into a requirement checklist and typed information needs, filtered by code for faithfulness to the user's words; it then answers from the whole conversation, asks the same questions again with quotes verified by code, and applies a guarded local repair. It needs no training or rubrics and makes about four LLM calls per task. On all 405 tasks with four frontier LLMs, QERA attains the highest solving rate on every LLM (21.0% on average, against 18.2% for the strongest of three inference-time baselines and 14.6% for direct answering) and leads every baseline significantly when pooled across LLMs, while using fewer tokens than PSCI and 4-5% of the tokens of Ctx2Skill. Ablations on GPT-6-Luna show that the gain is settled before the answer, by a fixed answer protocol (+3.8 rubric points) and the request-specific questions (+1.6), and that it is concentrated on implicit rubrics, with checking afterwards refining mainly numeric requirements.
articles.titleCn: 先问后答：用于情境学习的基于问题的证据推理架构（QERA）
articles.abstractCn: AI助手越来越多地被要求基于用户的个人网络痕迹进行推理：群聊记录、社区帖子、活动日志和修订历史。在CL-bench Life这一衡量现实情境学习能力的基准测试中，前沿的大型语言模型（LLM）平均仅解决不到五分之一任务。我们发现，请求并非规范：超过80%的基准测试评分标准与最终请求的内容词重合度不足60%，例如规则集的前两轮或所有符合用户标准的记录，直接回答的LLM仅通过67%的这些隐含评分标准，而其他LLM通过率为81%。我们提出了QERA，一种以问题驱动的证据推理架构，它在回答之前先提问。QERA首先将请求转化为需求清单和类型化的信息需求，并通过代码过滤以确保忠实于用户原话；然后从整个对话中回答，再次提出相同问题并使用代码验证引述，并应用受保护的本地修复。它无需训练或评分标准，每个任务大约调用四次LLM。在所有405个使用四种前沿LLM的任务中，QERA在每种LLM上均获得最高解决率（平均21.0%，优于三种推理时基线中最强的18.2%和直接回答的14.6%），并在跨LLM合并时显著领先所有基线，同时使用的token数量少于PSCI，仅为Ctx2Skill的4-5%。对GPT-6-Luna的消融实验表明，收益在回答前就已确定，通过固定的回答协议（+3.8评分点）和请求特定问题（+1.6），且主要集中在隐含评分标准上，后续检查主要优化数值要求。

articles.title: CoSA: The Conflict of Skills Attack in Real-World LLM Agent Ecosystems
articles.abstract: Agent Skills allow LLM agents to combine reusable capabilities, but checking each Skill in isolation cannot rule out policy violations when they are composed. We term such failures Conflict of Skills (CoS): artifacts or assessment signals produced for one purpose may be reused downstream without preserving the restrictions or authorization needed for their new use. Using controlled executions of publicly available Skills and matched single-Skill controls, we identify four recurring mechanisms behind CoS. Building on these findings, we introduce the Conflict of Skills Attack (CoSA), which adds locally admitted Skills to an existing pool to supply missing business operations (capability supplementation) or reshape artifact exchange, decision reuse, and target/action bindings (relationship reshaping). CoSA leaves existing Skills and runtime permissions unchanged. To evaluate this threat under autonomous Skill selection, we introduce CoSA-Bench, built from real-world Skills and controlled services, with 288 tasks across recruiting, finance, IT, and business, covering data leakage, unauthorized state modification, and unsafe execution. Across five LLMs and three agent harnesses, additions capped at 5% of each original pool raise the policy-violation rate from 35.02% to 58.45%, an increase of 23.43 percentage points. Trace analysis links compliant-to-violating transitions to cross-Skill dependencies involving the additions. Finally, we develop a lightweight harness-level guard that checks information flow and authorization before consequential actions. On OpenClaw recruiting tasks across five models, the guard reduces violations from 65.28% to 6.67%, while policy-compliant task completion on matched benign controls changes from 66.67% to 65.00%.
articles.titleCn: CoSA：现实世界大型语言模型智能体生态系统中的技能冲突攻击
articles.abstractCn: 代理技能允许大型语言模型代理组合可重用的功能，但当这些技能组合使用时，单独检查每个技能并不能排除策略违规。我们将此类故障称为技能冲突（CoS）：为特定目的生成的工件或评估信号可能在下游被重复使用，而未保留其新用途所需的限制或授权。通过控制执行公开可用的技能，并匹配单个技能控制，我们识别出CoS背后的四种反复出现的机制。基于这些发现，我们引入了技能冲突攻击（CoSA），该攻击向现有技能池中添加本地接受的技能，以补充缺失的业务操作（能力补充）或重塑工件交换、决策重用和目标/动作绑定（关系重塑）。CoSA不会更改现有的技能和运行时权限。为了在自主技能选择下评估这种威胁，我们引入了CoSA-Bench，该基准由真实世界的技能和控制服务构建，包含招聘、财务、IT和商业等领域的288个任务，涵盖数据泄露、未经授权的状态修改和执行不安全操作。在五个大型语言模型和三个代理框架中，将每个原始池的添加限制在5%以内，将策略违规率从35.02%提高到58.45%，增加了23.43个百分点。跟踪分析将合规到违规的转换与涉及添加的跨技能依赖联系起来。最后，我们开发了一个轻量级的框架级保护机制，在执行后续操作之前检查信息流和授权。在五个模型的OpenClaw招聘任务中，该保护机制将违规率从65.28%降至6.67%，而匹配良性控制的政策合规任务完成率从66.67%变为65.00%。

articles.title: Improving VLMs on Scientific Chart Analysis via Autonomous Evolution
articles.abstract: Understanding and operating with scientific charts is a standard approach in data analysis, and while humans are good at interpreting such charts, open vision-language models (VLMs) are known to perform poorly when it comes to question answering based on such data types. Motivated by an initial observation that many of their errors are due to inexact answering, we raise the following natural question: how much accuracy can we recover without changing the model at all? In this paper, we study this question by searching over inference programs and the code around a "frozen" version of the model. Using ideas from autonomous evolution (famously used in AlphaEvolve), we first start from a baseline inference program, and in each round we show an LLM judge the code together with a few failures on training questions, and ask for an improving evolutionary move. As usual in autonomous evolution approaches, the candidate programs are kept in a small pool ranked by training accuracy, and the next edit is performed on top-scorers from this pool. We run this approach on three VLMs and four popular benchmarks on scientific charts, and we measure the fraction of descriptive questions whose answer exactly matches the ground truth. The accuracy improves in all experimental settings. On average, it rises from 16.6% with the starting program to 41.3% with the evolved one, and the largest single increase is 55.2 percentage points. As a side benefit, our evolved program is 3.8x faster than the starting program, because short answers are easier to grade and faster to generate. Our results demonstrate that a large part of the observed errors arise due to the inference pipeline, and that optimizing it can improve the "frozen" VLM without the need to retrain it.
articles.titleCn: 通过自主进化改进科学图表分析中的视觉语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 理解和操作科学图表是数据分析的标准方法，尽管人类擅长解读此类图表，但开放式的视觉语言模型（VLMs）在基于此类数据类型进行问答时表现不佳。受最初观察到的许多错误是由于回答不准确这一现象的启发，我们提出了以下自然问题：在不改变模型本身的情况下，我们能够恢复多少准确性？在本文中，我们通过搜索“冻结”版本模型周围的推理程序和代码来研究这个问题。借鉴自主进化（在AlphaEvolve中著名使用）的思想，我们首先从一个基线推理程序开始，在每一轮中，我们向一个LLM裁判展示代码以及一些训练问题的失败案例，并要求其提出一个改进的进化步骤。像自主进化方法通常那样，候选程序保存在一个按训练准确性排名的小型池中，下一次编辑是在这个池中的顶级得分者上进行的。我们在三个VLMs和四个科学图表的流行基准上运行这种方法，并测量了描述性问题中答案与真实情况完全匹配的比例。在所有实验设置中，准确性都有所提高。平均而言，它从起始程序的16.6%上升到进化后的41.3%，最大单次增幅为55.2个百分点。作为附带的好处，我们的进化程序比起始程序快3.8倍，因为简短答案更容易评分且生成速度更快。我们的结果表明，观察到的很大一部分错误是由于推理管道引起的，而优化它可以提高“冻结”的VLM，而无需重新训练它。

articles.title: Reinforcement Learning Done Right for Explicit Confidence Targets
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can produce plausible but incorrect answers when they are uncertain, which can mislead users and undermine model reliability. Training models to abstain with reinforcement learning is a natural approach, but most existing methods use a fixed error penalty and therefore cannot adapt their behavior to different confidence requirements at inference time. We study \emph{explicit confidence targets}, where a user specifies a target \(p\) in the prompt and the model directly chooses whether to answer or abstain, with the goal of achieving an accuracy of at least \(p\) among answered questions. However, learning to respond to different confidence targets with a single model has proven difficult, and prior attempts have failed to distinguish different targets. We show that this failure comes from two problems: the reward signal that distinguishes different values of $p$ is often lost during optimization, while the original error penalty grows without bound as $p$ approaches one. We propose RLEC (\textbf{R}einforcement \textbf{L}earning with \textbf{E}xplicit \textbf{C}onfidence Targets), which preserves the learning signal needed to distinguish confidence targets, introduces a stable reward family that keeps the desired answer condition unchanged, and uses reward scheduling to balance effective learning and training stability. Together, these designs enable the first successful training of a single LLM for explicit confidence target control. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks and model scales show that RLEC largely preserves general capabilities and achieves competitive calibration performance. RLEC also supports fine-grained target control without an external decision system or threshold calibration after training. By making explicit confidence targets part of the trained policy, RLEC opens a new and more direct path toward behavioral calibration.
articles.titleCn: 针对明确置信目标的正确强化学习
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在不确定时可能会产生看似合理但错误的答案，这会误导用户并削弱模型可靠性。通过强化学习训练模型进行放弃是一种自然的方法，但大多数现有方法使用固定的错误惩罚，因此无法在推理时根据不同的置信度需求调整行为。我们研究了“显式置信度目标”，即用户在提示中指定目标 \(p\)，模型直接选择回答或放弃，目标是使回答问题的准确率至少达到 \(p\)。然而，用单个模型学习响应不同的置信度目标被证明是困难的，之前的尝试未能区分不同的目标。我们表明这种失败源于两个问题：区分不同 \(p\) 值的奖励信号在优化过程中经常丢失，而原始错误惩罚在 \(p\) 接近 1 时无界增长。我们提出了 RLEC（\textbf{R}einforcement \textbf{L}earning with \textbf{E}xplicit \textbf{C}onfidence Targets），该方法保留了区分置信度目标所需的信号，引入了一个稳定的奖励族以保持所需的回答条件不变，并使用奖励调度来平衡有效学习和训练稳定性。这些设计共同实现了首次成功训练单个 LLM 以进行显式置信度目标控制。在多种基准和模型规模上的大量实验表明，RLEC 大大保留了泛化能力，并实现了具有竞争力的校准性能。RLEC 还支持训练后的细粒度目标控制，无需外部决策系统或阈值校准。通过将显式置信度目标作为训练策略的一部分，RLEC 开辟了一条新的、更直接的行为校准路径。

articles.title: From Questions to Queries to Insights: A Schema-Grounded Agentic Workflow for Natural-Language Crash Data Analysis
articles.abstract: Transportation agencies maintain extensive crash databases to identify safety priorities, evaluate countermeasures, and guide resource allocation. Making these data accessible to practitioners requires flexible ways to translate analytical questions into reliable results. Existing dashboards support predefined analyses, while additional requests often depend on specialists who understand database queries, coded fields, and agency conventions. This study presents CrashDB-QA, a fully local, schema-grounded agentic workflow that enables natural-language analysis of crash databases. Specialized components interpret questions, generate and validate read-only SQL, execute queries, and explain the results. A shared knowledge base grounds query construction in the agency's data dictionary and safety-analysis conventions, while recorded intermediate outputs support inspection and auditing. An optional extension, CrashDB-QA+, checks the alignment among the question, query, and execution result and supplies evidence for iterative repair. We evaluate the workflow on a frozen snapshot of 4.4 million Wisconsin crash records using a new benchmark of 300 questions across ten analytical categories and nine local open-weight models. Domain grounding substantially improves query accuracy, and a code-specialized 7B model provides the best accuracy-latency balance among the tested models. Compositional analyses remain more difficult than routine retrieval, particularly comparisons between groups or periods. Verification improves performance when the Judge uses authoritative field definitions and the Refiner receives execution evidence, whereas additional checking alone offers no consistent benefit. These findings demonstrate the potential of locally deployed, domain-grounded workflows to broaden access to crash analysis and identify the reasoning and verification capabilities needed for reliable use.
articles.titleCn: 从问题到查询到洞见：一种基于模式的自主工作流，用于自然语言事故数据分析
articles.abstractCn: 交通机构维护着庞大的事故数据库，用于识别安全优先事项、评估反制措施以及指导资源配置。为了让这些数据可供从业者使用，需要灵活地将分析问题转化为可靠结果。现有的仪表板支持预定义分析，而额外的请求通常需要理解数据库查询、编码字段和机构惯例的专业人士。本研究介绍了CrashDB-QA，这是一个完全本地化、基于模式的代理工作流，能够对事故数据库进行自然语言分析。专业组件解释问题、生成和验证只读SQL、执行查询并解释结果。共享知识库使查询构建基于机构的数据字典和安全分析惯例，而记录的中间输出支持检查和审计。可选的扩展CrashDB-QA+检查问题、查询和执行结果之间的对齐性，并提供迭代修复的证据。我们在440万条威斯康星州事故记录的冻结快照上评估了该工作流，使用了一个包含10个分析类别和9个本地开放权重模型的300个问题的最新基准。领域接地显著提高了查询准确性，而代码专用的7B模型在测试模型中提供了最佳的准确性与延迟平衡。组合分析比常规检索更困难，特别是组间或时期的比较。当裁判使用权威字段定义时，验证会提高性能，而精炼器接收执行证据时也是如此，而单独的额外检查则没有一致的好处。这些发现证明了本地部署、领域接地的流程在扩大事故分析访问权限以及识别可靠使用所需的推理和验证能力方面的潜力。

articles.title: SimPOTrans: Self-Adaptation for Offline-to-Simultaneous Speech Translation via Reinforcement Learning
articles.abstract: Simultaneous speech translation (SimulST) aims to translate ongoing speech with low latency while preserving translation quality. Recent studies have adopted large language models (LLMs) for SimulST and formulated it as a multi-turn dialogue task for efficient generation, achieving state-of-the-art performance. However, existing dialogue-style SimulST approaches typically rely on specialized training schemes to acquire simultaneous translation behavior, either using synthesized read/write trajectories, which may provide suboptimal training signals, or jointly optimizing translation quality and latency, whose competing objectives may cause optimization instability. In this paper, we introduce SimPOTrans, a reinforcement learning (RL) framework that enables offline speech translation models to self-adapt to dialogue-style SimulST. Through a simple two-stage RL post-training pipeline, SimPOTrans rewards an offline model for exhibiting translation behaviors beneficial to simultaneous scenarios when given partial speech inputs, thereby enabling offline-to-simultaneous self-adaptation without synthesized read/write trajectories or explicit latency optimization. At inference time, SimPOTrans requires no external decision policy and enables flexible quality--latency control by simply adjusting the chunk size of speech input. Experiments on the ACL 60/60 and MCIF benchmarks across three language directions (En$\rightarrow$De, En$\rightarrow$Zh, and En$\rightarrow$Ja) demonstrate that SimPOTrans outperforms several strong baselines, achieving a superior quality--latency trade-off.
articles.titleCn: SimPOTrans：基于强化学习的离线到实时语音翻译的自适应方法
articles.abstractCn: 语音实时翻译（SimulST）旨在以低延迟翻译正在进行的语音，同时保持翻译质量。近期研究采用大型语言模型（LLMs）进行SimulST，并将其形式化为多轮对话任务以实现高效生成，取得了最先进的性能。然而，现有的对话式SimulST方法通常依赖于专门的训练方案来获取实时翻译行为，要么使用合成的读写轨迹，这可能提供次优的训练信号，要么联合优化翻译质量和延迟，其竞争目标可能导致优化不稳定。在本文中，我们引入了SimPOTrans，一个强化学习（RL）框架，使离线语音翻译模型能够自适应于对话式SimulST。通过简单的两阶段RL后训练流程，SimPOTrans在给定部分语音输入时奖励离线模型表现出对实时场景有益的翻译行为，从而实现离线到实时的自适应，无需合成的读写轨迹或显式的延迟优化。在推理时，SimPOTrans无需外部决策策略，并通过简单地调整语音输入的块大小来实现灵活的质量-延迟控制。在ACL 60/60和MCIF基准测试上，跨越三种语言方向（En→De、En→Zh和En→Ja）的实验表明，SimPOTrans优于多个强基线，实现了更优越的质量-延迟权衡。

articles.title: Synthetic Child-Adult Interactions Are Not Developmentally Plausible
articles.abstract: Synthetic data has become a common resource for training language models, and this trend has spilled over into research on developmentally plausible language modeling. However, it remains unclear whether LM-generated child-adult interactions actually resemble natural ones. We compare the synthetic TinyDialogues dataset to natural dialogue across a broad range of linguistic measures. While synthetic data matches natural data on the lexical level, it drastically underestimates the messy, fragmented nature of spoken interaction. To mitigate this, we propose instruction-tuning with data created from real dialogues, and show in a pilot study that a small model approximates the statistical tendencies of natural data after moderate parameter-efficient fine-tuning.
articles.titleCn: 合成儿童-成人互动在发展上并不可信
articles.abstractCn: 合成数据已成为训练语言模型的一种常见资源，这一趋势也扩展到了关于发展上合理语言模型的研究中。然而，目前尚不清楚语言模型生成的儿童-成人互动是否真正类似于自然互动。我们将合成数据集TinyDialogues与自然对话在广泛的语言学指标上进行了比较。尽管合成数据在词汇层面上与自然数据相匹配，但它严重低估了口语互动的混乱和碎片化特性。为了缓解这一问题，我们提出了使用真实对话创建的数据进行指令微调，并在一项初步研究中表明，经过适度参数高效的微调后，小型模型能够近似自然数据的统计趋势。

articles.title: When the Persona Contradicts the Line: Diagnosing Plan-to-Synthesis Failures in Chain-of-Thought TTS
articles.abstract: Chain-of-thought TTS systems rely on language-model planners to translate persona and context into vocal delivery, but it is unclear where this intent is lost when the requested affect conflicts with lexical sentiment. We introduce a bilingual Japanese--English persona--line conflict benchmark in which each item pairs one line with congruent and conflicting personas and pre-declares the expected acoustic direction. We probe this direction in the planner-generated delivery phrase, the planner-written emotion vector, the QwenEmotion-generated vector, and the rendered waveform. Planner outputs are usually direction-correct, while downstream agreement can be substantially lower. Bypassing QwenEmotion provides only modest gains over the full planner-controlled Base. Supervising QwenEmotion raises the direction rate to 75% in Japanese and 84% in English. A learned text-to-latent interface reaches the highest English rate of 89% and the highest Japanese arousal rate of 88%. These results show that learned repair of the plan-to-synthesis interface can recover counter-textual delivery, although its effect differs across languages and acoustic axes.
articles.titleCn: 当人格与线路相悖：诊断思维链TTS中的计划-合成失败
articles.abstractCn: 思维链式TTS系统依赖于语言模型规划器将角色和上下文转化为语音表达，但在请求的情感与词汇情感冲突时，这种意图的丢失情况尚不明确。我们引入了一个双语日语-英语角色-台词冲突基准，其中每个项目将一条台词与一致和不一致的角色配对，并预先声明预期的声学方向。我们探究了规划器生成的表达短语、规划器书写的情感向量、QwenEmotion生成的向量以及渲染的波形中的这一方向。规划器输出通常方向正确，而下游的协议率可能显著较低。绕过QwenEmotion仅比完全由规划器控制的Base提供适度的增益。监督QwenEmotion将日语的方向率提高到75%，英语提高到84%。一个学习型文本到潜空间的接口达到了最高的英语率89%和最高的日语唤醒率88%。这些结果表明，学习型计划到合成接口的修复可以恢复反文本交付，尽管其效果在不同语言和声学轴上有所不同。

articles.title: Reason or Recite: Complementary Specialists with an LLM Judge for Traffic Anomaly Reasoning
articles.abstract: Road anomalies such as collisions, violations, and sudden hazards demand more from video understanding than detection: a practical system must verify what happened, describe the scene, and explain the cause. We find these competences pull in opposite directions for vision-language models: closed-form questions reward precise, evidence-grounded reasoning, while open-ended answers are scored by similarity to reference text, where matching the annotation style matters as much as reasoning correctly. We present Reason-or-Recite (RoR), a two-specialist framework for the Traffic Anomaly Reasoning track of the 2026 AI City Challenge. RoR (1) rewrites the official chain-of-thought annotations into a structured, temporally grounded schema and LoRA-tunes a 9B vision-language model on the enhanced traces; (2) fine-tunes a 4-bit-quantized 27B model on answers alone, absorbing the annotation style; and (3) selects between the two candidates per question with a training-free LLM judge. RoR ranks first on the in-domain leaderboard with mean score 0.6788.
articles.comment: 18 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at the AI City Challenge Workshop, ECCV 2026. 1st place in Track 3 (Traffic Anomaly Reasoning)
articles.titleCn: 推理或复述：拥有LLM裁判的交通异常推理互补专家
articles.abstractCn: 道路异常情况，如碰撞、违规和突发危险，对视频理解的要求比检测更高：一个实用的系统必须验证发生了什么，描述场景，并解释原因。我们发现这些能力对于视觉语言模型来说是相互矛盾的：封闭式问题奖励精确的、基于证据的推理，而开放式答案则通过参考文本的相似度进行评分，其中匹配注释风格的重要性与正确推理同等。我们提出了Reason-or-Recite（RoR），这是一个用于2026年AI城市挑战交通异常推理赛道的双专家框架。RoR（1）将官方思维链注释改写为结构化、时间相关的模式，并在增强的轨迹上LoRA微调一个9B视觉语言模型；（2）仅基于答案对4位量化的27B模型进行微调，吸收注释风格；（3）使用一个无训练的LLM裁判为每个问题在两个候选答案之间进行选择。RoR在领域排行榜上排名第一，平均得分为0.6788。

articles.title: Diagnosing and Mitigating Long-Session Degradation in Full-Duplex Speech Models
articles.abstract: End-to-end full-duplex spoken dialogue models enable natural, real-time spoken interactions with interruptions, backchannels, and overlapping speech. Prior evaluations have assessed diverse interaction capabilities and identified some degradation patterns across conversational turns. However, how model behavior evolves over extended sessions remains insufficiently understood. In this work, we address this gap by systematically characterizing long-session degradation and developing efficient methods to mitigate it. We introduce a closed-loop evaluation framework for long-session stability and apply it to several publicly available full-duplex speech models, revealing degradation over time in responsiveness, spoken content quality, and voice consistency. To mitigate this degradation, we propose a self-distillation-based training framework for lightweight LoRA adaptation that improves long-session stability with a small amount of additional training. We further introduce a two-resolution context (TRC) architecture that preserves recent interactions in full detail while compressing older interaction history into key-value representations. We evaluate our methods on three models with distinct architectures, assessing long-session stability, information retention, and computational efficiency. Across all three models, we show that LoRA adaptation mitigates performance degradation over ten-minute sessions, while adding TRC extends these gains beyond the training session length and reduces KV-cache growth by more than 90%.
articles.comment: The project page is available at https://kimjunho333.github.io/dmlsd-fdsm/
articles.titleCn: 诊断和缓解全双工语音模型中的长会话退化问题
articles.abstractCn: 端到端全双工语音对话模型能够实现自然、实时的语音交互，支持打断、反馈音和重叠语音。以往评估主要关注多样化的交互能力，并识别出对话轮次中的一些性能退化模式。然而，模型行为在长时间会话中的演变规律尚不明确。本研究通过系统性地刻画长时间会话的退化现象，并开发高效缓解方法来填补这一空白。我们引入了用于长时间会话稳定性的闭环评估框架，并将其应用于多个公开的全双工语音模型，揭示了响应性、语音内容质量和声音一致性随时间推移的退化。为缓解这一问题，我们提出了基于自蒸馏训练框架的轻量级LoRA自适应方法，通过少量额外训练提升长时间会话稳定性。此外，我们引入了双分辨率上下文（TRC）架构，在保留近期交互细节的同时，将较早的交互历史压缩为键值表示。我们在三种具有不同架构的模型上评估了我们的方法，考察长时间会话稳定性、信息保留和计算效率。结果表明，LoRA自适应能缓解十分钟会话中的性能退化，而TRC则将这一优势扩展至训练会话时长之外，并将键值缓存增长降低超过90%。

articles.title: AskGLP1: A Knowledge Graph LLM Agent for Exploring GLP-1 Experience from Online Patient Narratives
articles.abstract: GLP-1 medications are increasingly used for weight management, and many people share their experiences online. These narratives show why people take the drugs and what they experience, but they remain unstructured and disconnected from formal pharmacovigilance. We therefore present AskGLP1, a system that transforms online patient narratives into a knowledge graph (KG) and answers questions about medication experiences. Through an LLM-assisted pipeline grounded in the MedDRA terminology, AskGLP1 screens nearly 8.5 million Reddit posts for medication experiences and distills 163,135 of them, with 2,506 WebMD reviews, into a KG of 385,790 drug-side-effect and drug-purpose relations. We find that GLP-1 experiences are source- and drug-specific. Online narratives share the most common gastrointestinal symptoms with FAERS, but they foreground everyday burdens such as fatigue and food aversion, whereas FAERS reports more often include injection-site reactions and selected serious diagnoses such as pancreatitis. We further find that posts report less nausea and vomiting for tirzepatide than for semaglutide, more fatigue for Wegovy than Ozempic and for Zepbound than Mounjaro. Evaluations show that the agent answers with verifiable evidence and declines requests for medical advice. Our findings reveal gaps between what FAERS captures and what people report online, and they call for patient-centered approaches to pharmacovigilance. Code, prompts, and evaluation questions are available at https://github.com/ZhaoqianXue/AskGLP1.
articles.titleCn: AskGLP1：一个基于知识图谱的LLM智能体，用于从在线患者叙述中探索GLP-1体验
articles.abstractCn: GLP-1药物越来越多地用于体重管理，许多人会在网上分享他们的使用经验。这些叙述展示了人们使用药物的原因以及他们的体验，但它们仍然是非结构化的，并且与正式的药物警戒脱节。因此，我们提出了AskGLP1系统，该系统将在线患者叙述转化为知识图谱（KG），并回答关于药物使用体验的问题。通过一个基于MedDRA术语表、由大型语言模型辅助的流程，AskGLP1筛选了近850万Reddit帖子中的药物使用体验，并从中提炼出163,135条，加上2,506条WebMD评论，构建了一个包含385,790个药物副作用和药物用途关系的知识图谱。我们发现GLP-1的使用体验具有来源和药物特异性。在线叙述与FAERS（美国食品药品监督管理局不良事件报告系统）分享最常见的胃肠道症状，但它们更突出日常负担，如疲劳和食物厌恶，而FAERS报告则更常包括注射部位反应和选定的严重诊断，如胰腺炎。我们进一步发现，关于替尔泊肽的帖子报告的恶心和呕吐少于司美格鲁肽，关于Wegovy的疲劳多于Ozempic，关于Zepbound的疲劳多于Mounjaro。评估表明，该系统以可验证的证据回答问题，并拒绝提供医疗建议。我们的研究揭示了FAERS捕捉到的内容与人们在网上的报告之间的差距，并呼吁以患者为中心的药物警戒方法。代码、提示和评估问题可在https://github.com/ZhaoqianXue/AskGLP1获取。

articles.title: SVD-Attention: Efficiently Analyzing Attention Blocks in Transformers
articles.abstract: Pretrained transformers spend a large share of their inference compute inside self-attention, yet the per-head query-key interaction is structurally low-rank by construction. We ask a diagnostic question: across layers and architectures, which heads actually use the full rank budget on real data, and which do not? We propose SVD-Attention, a post-hoc method that decomposes the per-head interaction matrix $M_h$ and scores every singular mode by both its spectral magnitude and its activation variance across tokens on a small calibration set. The score keeps the modes the head can amplify and that real data actually activates, and discards the rest; the resulting factorization is exact for the retained modes and needs no finetuning. Across seven pretrained models and five task types, the diagnostic finds a task-dependent pattern: redundancy sits in the early to middle layers for sentiment and image classification and for generation, and in the late layers for dense prediction and extractive question answering. It is also predictive: truncating the layers it flags costs at most $1.75$ F1, while truncating the same number of layers elsewhere in the same model costs up to $50$ F1. SVD-Attention is an analysis tool rather than a compression method: acting on it reduces inference FLOPs by $0.8$-$1.5\%$ on its own and by $8$-$11\%$ when composed with weight pruning, with $0$-$4\%$ change in task quality.
articles.titleCn: SVD-Attention：高效分析Transformer中的注意力模块
articles.abstractCn: 预训练的变换器在推理过程中将大量计算资源消耗在自注意力机制中，然而每个头的查询-键交互在结构上是由设计保证的低秩。我们提出一个诊断问题：在各个层和架构中，哪些头真正在真实数据上使用了全部秩预算，哪些没有？我们提出了SVD-Attention，这是一种后处理方法，它分解每个头的交互矩阵$M_h$，并通过其在小校准集上对每个奇异模态的谱幅度和激活方差进行评分。该评分保留了头可以放大且真实数据实际激活的模态，并丢弃了其余部分；由此产生的分解对保留的模态是精确的，并且无需微调。在七个预训练模型和五种任务类型中，诊断发现了一种任务相关的模式：冗余存在于情感和图像分类以及生成任务的早期到中期层，而在密集预测和抽取式问答任务的后期层。它也是预测性的：截断它标记的层最多损失$1.75$ F1，而截断同一模型中其他相同数量的层最多损失$50$ F1。SVD-Attention是一种分析工具而非压缩方法：仅作用于它可减少推理FLOPs $0.8$-$1.5\%$，与权重剪枝组合时减少$8$-$11\%$，任务质量变化为$0$-$4\%。

articles.title: Improving Reasoning with Rollout Agreement for Group-Based Policy Optimization
articles.abstract: Recent methods for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) use rollout diversity to improve reasoning performance or training efficiency. Despite these gains, the extent to which differences among correct-answer rollouts reflect useful alternative reasoning or unresolved errors remains poorly understood. We investigate this question through a blind paired analysis of a model trained with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), comparing the highest- and lowest-agreement correct-answer traces for the same problem. Across 126 pairs, low-agreement traces have more spurious reasoning than high-agreement traces (35% vs. 22%), including internal inconsistencies and misuse of problem conditions. Based on these findings, we propose RoAR (Rollout-Agreement Reward), which adds reasoning-level agreement to GRPO's rewards for verified-correct rollouts. RoAR computes this signal from existing on-policy rollout groups, requiring no human-written rationales, additional sampling, or separately trained process evaluator. On five mathematical reasoning benchmarks, the 1.5B GRPO-RoAR model reaches 55.5% mean pass@1 under zero-shot evaluation using 7K training examples, exceeding GRPO and GRPO-CARE by 6.0 and 5.5 percentage points. A separate blind audit of 100 problems answered correctly by all four 1.5B models finds spurious rates of 18% for GRPO-RoAR, 32% for GRPO, 27% for GRPO-CARE, and 37% for DRA-GRPO. Our findings identify reasoning validity as an important consideration when using rollout differences to guide learning. Our code is available at https://github.com/ldi-kyunghee/RoAR.
articles.titleCn: 基于分组策略优化的Rollout协议改进推理能力
articles.abstractCn: 近期可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）方法利用策略多样性来提升推理性能或训练效率。尽管取得了这些进步，正确答案策略之间的差异究竟反映了有用的替代推理还是未解决的错误，这一点仍不甚明了。我们通过分析使用组相对策略优化（GRPO）训练的模型，对同一问题的最高和最低一致性正确答案轨迹进行盲法配对分析，来探究这一问题。在126对数据中，低一致性轨迹比高一致性轨迹包含更多虚假推理（35% vs. 22%），包括内部矛盾和问题条件的误用。基于这些发现，我们提出了RoAR（策略多样性奖励），该奖励机制为GRPO中经过验证的正确策略轨迹增加了推理层级的共识度。RoAR从现有的策略轨迹组中计算这一信号，无需人工编写的推理、额外采样或单独训练的过程评估器。在五个数学推理基准测试中，1.5B GRPO-RoAR模型在零样本评估下使用7K训练样本时，平均准确率达到55.5%，比GRPO和GRPO-CARE分别高出6.0和5.5个百分点。对100个所有4个1.5B模型均正确回答的问题进行盲法审计发现，GRPO-RoAR的虚假推理率为18%，GRPO为32%，GRPO-CARE为27%，DRA-GRPO为37%。我们的研究结果表明，在利用策略差异指导学习时，推理有效性是一个重要的考量因素。我们的代码可在https://github.com/ldi-kyunghee/RoAR获取。

articles.title: Correlation-Aware Exploration for Long-Trace Reasoning
articles.abstract: Reasoning models trained with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) now produce chains of thought thousands of tokens long, and recent studies reveal that such training is prone to policy collapse. Entropy regularization is the standard remedy, but it works by pushing probability mass away from the few tokens that carry it and toward the vast low-probability tail of the vocabulary, and it applies this force once for every token of the reasoning trace. This puts the bonus in direct conflict with the entropy decay that convergence requires, and makes its coefficient difficult to set in the long-trace regime. To resolve this tension, we propose Info-GRPO, an information-theoretic framework that cultivates correlation between the policy and a latent prior. Rather than raising entropy everywhere, Info-GRPO builds on the mutual information between a latent variable and the trajectory it induces: augmenting prompts with latent seeds during training lets the model explore diverse policies correlated with the prior, while the seed-conditioned entropy is guided toward convergence. Diversity is therefore carried across whole reasoning traces rather than by per-token randomness, and exploration no longer fights entropy reduction. Experiments show that Info-GRPO outperforms vanilla GRPO and entropy-regularized GRPO across diverse reasoning benchmarks. On AIME24, it improves $Avg@8$ over GRPO by 3.75%, 1.66%, 4.16%, and 4.17% on four backbones, and it reaches the same majority-vote accuracy with $8\times$ fewer samples. Code and models will be publicly released.
articles.comment: 28 pages, 6 figures. Accepted at the Workshop on Long-Context Foundation Models (LCFM), NeurIPS 2026
articles.titleCn: 长轨迹推理中的相关性感知探索
articles.abstractCn: 使用组相对策略优化（GRPO）训练的推理模型现在能生成数千个token的推理链，而近期研究表明这种训练容易导致策略崩溃。熵正则化是标准的补救措施，但它通过将概率质量从承载它的少数token推向词汇表庞大且低概率的尾部来工作，并且对推理轨迹的每个token都应用一次这种力量。这使奖励与收敛所需的熵衰减直接冲突，并使系数在长轨迹情况下难以设置。为了解决这种张力，我们提出了Info-GRPO，这是一个信息论框架，它培养策略与潜在先验之间的相关性。Info-GRPO不是在所有地方提高熵，而是基于潜在变量与其诱导轨迹之间的互信息：在训练期间用潜在种子增强提示，让模型探索与先验相关的多样化策略，同时种子条件下的熵被引导向收敛。因此，多样性是通过整个推理轨迹而不是每个token的随机性来传递的，探索不再与熵减少相冲突。实验表明，Info-GRPO在多种推理基准测试中优于普通的GRPO和熵正则化的GRPO。在AIME24上，它在四个主干网络上比GRPO提高了3.75%、1.66%、4.16%和4.17%的Avg@8，并且使用8倍的更少样本达到了相同的多数投票准确率。代码和模型将公开发布。

articles.title: What Outcome RL Buys: Finishing, Reliability, Rarely Reach
articles.abstract: Outcome RL raises pass@1 but not pass@k at large k (Yue et al., 2025). But every pass@1 is scored under a token budget. Every recipe also trains under one. On physics and math problems at fixed token budgets, we compare the pass@1 of 20 released RL models (1.5B to 32B) with that of the thinking models they started from. We ask whether each pass@1 gain is changed behaviour or new knowledge. We divide each change in pass@1 into three parts. Finishing measures answering before the budget runs out. Reliability measures being right once finished. Reach measures problems RL solves that its base answered wrongly in all eight tries, minus problems the base solves that RL answered wrongly in all eight. We find four things. (1) Where the base often hits the token budget before answering, most of the change, gain or loss, is finishing (82% at 4k and 8k). Given more tokens, the base closes most of the finishing gap itself. (2) Where the base has enough tokens, the gain is reliability: the RL model is graded right more often, even on problems both finish. (3) By our definition, RL rarely solves what its base cannot. Reach adds at most 2.1 percentage points on any of our four physics and math sets. We checked 144 physics problems that only the RL model solved. Of these, 3.5% hold up when resampled or read. In a random sample, nine of ten new RL steps a human confirmed also appear in the base's samples. (4) In a small-scale RL run on an 8B model, the gain on new problems is finishing, with reliability flat. Supplying each problem's physical setup was not shown to improve on plain RL.
