articles.titleCn: RL购买的结果：完成、可靠性、很少达到
articles.abstractCn: 结果RL在较大k值时提升了pass@1但未提升pass@k（Yue等人，2025）。但每次pass@1评分都受限于token预算。每个模型训练时也遵循这一预算。在固定的token预算下，针对物理和数学问题，我们比较了20个已发布的RL模型（1.5B至32B）与其初始思考模型的pass@1表现。我们探究每个pass@1的提升是源于行为改变还是新知识。我们将每个pass@1的变化分为三部分：完成度衡量在预算用尽前回答问题的能力；可靠性衡量完成回答后的正确率；覆盖度衡量RL解决的、初始模型在八次尝试中均回答错误的问题，减去初始模型解决的、RL在八次尝试中均回答错误的问题。我们发现了四点：(1) 初始模型常在预算用尽前无法回答，此时大部分变化——无论是提升还是下降——主要来自完成度（在4k和8k预算下分别为82%）。给予更多token后，初始模型自身弥补了大部分完成度差距。(2) 当初始模型拥有足够token时，提升体现在可靠性上：RL模型在完成回答的问题上正确率更高。(3) 根据我们的定义，RL很少解决初始模型无法解决的问题。在四个物理和数学数据集上，覆盖度最多增加2.1个百分点。我们检查了144个仅RL模型能解决的物理问题。其中3.5%在重采样或重读时依然成立。在随机样本中，人类确认的十个新RL步骤中有九个出现在初始模型的样本中。(4) 在8B模型的小规模RL运行中，新问题的提升来自完成度，可靠性保持不变。提供每个问题的物理设置并未证明比普通RL有更好的表现。

articles.title: FATE-5: Faithful Alignment of Trait Expression for Continuous Big Five Personality Control
articles.abstract: Controlling personality in large language models is important for building conversational agents that can be customized to different users and interaction settings. However, existing personality control methods often face a tradeoff between strong trait expression and natural dialogue generation. We introduce FATE-5, Faithful Alignment of Trait Expression for the Big Five, a two-stage framework that separates personality encoding from naturalness alignment. FATE-5 first learns continuous soft prompt representations of Big Five profiles using dialogue supervision and an auxiliary survey objective. It then improves dialogue naturalness through preference alignment based on both dialogue quality and personality agreement. Across three language model backbones, FATE-5 maintains strong trait expression while achieving substantially higher dialogue naturalness than other trait-strong methods. On held-out questionnaires, it achieves monotonicity correlations of 0.97-0.99 and recovery RMSE of 8.9-12.4, substantially improving over the evaluated baselines. These results demonstrate effective continuous personality control while maintaining natural conversational behavior.
articles.titleCn: FATE-5：特质表达的忠实对齐，用于连续型五大人格控制
articles.abstractCn: 在大型语言模型中控制个性对于构建可针对不同用户和交互场景进行定制的对话代理至关重要。然而，现有的个性控制方法往往在强烈的特质表达和自然对话生成之间面临权衡。我们引入了FATE-5，即“五大性格特质的忠实对齐”，这是一种分两阶段的框架，将个性编码与自然度对齐分离。FATE-5首先利用对话监督和辅助调查目标学习五大性格特质的连续软提示表示。然后通过基于对话质量和个性一致性的偏好对齐来提升对话的自然度。在三个语言模型主干上，FATE-5在保持强烈特质表达的同时，实现了比其他特质强烈的方略显著更高的对话自然度。在保留的问卷中，它实现了0.97-0.99的单调性相关性和8.9-12.4的恢复RMSE，显著优于评估的基线。这些结果表明，在保持自然对话行为的同时实现了有效的连续个性控制。

articles.title: NumTrace: Auditing the Number Provenance of Financial Analyst Agents
articles.abstract: A numerical claim generated by a financial analyst agent can match a number in a company filing but refer to the wrong entity, concept, period, unit or scope. A check based on reference answers can mark such an answer as wrong but does not explain why it fails. In this paper, we present NumTrace, a new benchmark that audits the provenance of each numerical claim made by financial analyst agents: its source and financial semantics. NumTrace currently has 540 questions over 2,163 SEC EDGAR documents. To the best of our knowledge, it is the first numerical benchmark about who holds a company's shares (Form 13F) and what its executives are owed (Item 402(i)). On a frozen snapshot of these documents, we build the reference answers according to accounting rules. NumTrace then gives each claim three separate verdicts: value, binding and support. By retaining separate value and binding verdicts, NumTrace detects right number, wrong account (RNWA) errors: a claim has an RNWA error when it passes the value check but fails the binding check. The RNWA rate quantifies the gap between value-only and joint value-and-binding pass rates. Finally, we audit three agents, Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Astra and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. RNWA errors make up 67.5-81.8% of each agent's failing claims. In particular, on 13F co-filing group questions, about 91% of claims pass the value check, but fewer than half pass the binding check.
articles.titleCn: NumTrace：审计金融分析师代理的数字溯源
articles.abstractCn: 金融分析师代理生成的数字声明可能与公司文件中的某个数字相匹配，但可能指代错误的实体、概念、时期、单位或范围。基于参考答案的检查可以判定此类答案为错误，但无法解释其失败原因。在本文中，我们提出了NumTrace，一个新的基准，用于审计金融分析师代理生成的每个数字声明的来源和财务语义。NumTrace目前包含540个问题，涵盖2,163份SEC EDGAR文件。据我们所知，它是关于谁持有公司股份（13F表格）以及公司高管应得报酬（第402(i)项）的第一个数字基准。在这些文件的冻结快照上，我们根据会计规则构建参考答案。NumTrace随后对每个声明给出三个独立的裁决：数值、约束性和支持性。通过保留独立的数值和约束性裁决，NumTrace检测到正确数字、错误账户（RNWA）错误：当声明通过数值检查但未通过约束性检查时，即存在RNWA错误。RNWA率量化了仅通过数值检查与联合通过数值和约束性检查的通过率之间的差距。最后，我们审计了三个代理：Claude Opus 5.5、GPT-6 Astra和DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash。RNWA错误占每个代理失败声明的67.5-81.8%。特别是，在13F共同申报组问题中，约91%的声明通过数值检查，但不到一半通过约束性检查。

articles.title: ThinkBit: Search Codewords, Recalibrate Scales, Select by Reasoning
articles.abstract: Reasoning language models generate thousands of tokens per answer, and generation speed is limited by memory bandwidth, so storing weights in two bits instead of bfloat16 can potentially make inference 8$\times$ cheaper. Two-bit methods are usually judged by perplexity and multiple-choice question-answering accuracy, both of which say little about whether a model can still reason through more difficult problems. We present ThinkBit, a strictly scalar two-bit framework built to preserve reasoning, in which every weight is an integer codeword times a bfloat16 scale shared by a group of weights. We first use a sensitivity metric to assign each layer a ternary, 2-bit, or 3-bit tier to allocate bitwidths optimally among layers. This is followed by a layerwise Gumbel-softmax-based scalar quantization algorithm that searches for optimal codewords block by block. Since a layerwise scheme does not capture how quantized layers interact with each other, we recalibrate scales, with the codewords frozen, using a knowledge-distillation-based loss against the teacher model. We then perform a short quantization-aware training (QAT) stage that lets the model mimic the base model's distribution by reassigning codewords. Finally, a paired reasoning test on training problems selects the final checkpoint between the recalibration stage and the QAT stage. On Qwen3-1.7B at matched size, our recalibrated checkpoint scores 46.7 on MATH-500 against 30.0 for EfficientQAT trained on the same data, and 73.0 after QAT on reasoning traces; at 0.52 GB it is smaller than every published 2-bit GGUF of the model yet more accurate on MATH-500. We show that this framework scales and up to 14B, a 3.74 GB model scores 94.8 on MATH-500, against 97.5 for the 29.5 GB bfloat16 model.
articles.titleCn: ThinkBit：搜索代码词，重新校准刻度，通过推理选择
articles.abstractCn: 推理语言模型每生成一个答案会生成数千个token，生成速度受内存带宽限制，因此将权重以2比特存储而不是bfloat16可以潜在地使推理成本降低8倍。通常通过困惑度和多项选择题问答准确度来评估二比特方法，但这两者都不能说明模型是否仍能通过更复杂的问题进行推理。我们提出了ThinkBit，一个严格标量的二比特框架，旨在保留推理能力，其中每个权重都是一个整数码字乘以一个由一组权重共享的bfloat16缩放因子。我们首先使用敏感性度量将每一层分配为三元、2比特或3比特级别，以在层之间优化分配比特宽度。随后采用基于Gumbel-softmax的逐层标量量化算法，逐块搜索最优码字。由于逐层方案不能捕捉量化层之间的相互作用，我们使用基于知识蒸馏的损失（相对于教师模型）重新校准缩放因子，同时冻结码字。然后，我们进行一个短量化感知训练（QAT）阶段，通过重新分配码字使模型模拟基础模型的分布。最后，在训练问题上的配对推理测试中选择重新校准阶段和QAT阶段之间的最终检查点。在匹配大小的Qwen3-1.7B上，我们重新校准的检查点在MATH-500上得分46.7，而同一数据上训练的EfficientQAT得分为30.0，在推理轨迹上进行QAT后得分为73.0；其大小为0.52 GB，比已发布的所有2比特GGUF模型更小，但在MATH-500上更准确。我们展示了该框架可扩展性，一个3.74 GB的模型在MATH-500上得分94.8，而29.5 GB的bfloat16模型得分为97.5。

articles.title: RubriX: A Fast, Fine-Tunable Non-Autoregressive Rubric Judge
articles.abstract: Rubric-based evaluation asks which level of a rubric a response meets. It is usually done by prompting a large language model (LLM) as a judge, which needs a generative call per judgment and reads every level description, so its cost grows with the rubric. We present RubriX, a rubric judge whose architecture is inspired by contrastive language models (CLM): a LoRA-adapted encoder embeds the input and each level description, and a softmax over scaled cosine similarities gives a probability for every level without text generation. Trained on public rubric data and proprietary synthetic data, RubriX reaches 75.4% exact accuracy on held-out rubrics, against 57.1% for TypeSafe's Jev and 49.8% for a Qwen3-8B judge. On eight human-labelled benchmark sets it is within 6 percentage points of Jev's accuracy on most of them, while Jev keeps a larger lead on two and ranks responses best on average; against the results reported in the G-Eval paper, RubriX outperforms G-Eval with GPT-3.5 on every SummEval dimension and both QAGS subsets. With level embeddings cached, RubriX's latency stays at about 28 ms per judgment as level descriptions grow from 10 to 3,000 tokens, while Jev's (approximate network time subtracted) rises from 44 ms to 211 ms and the Qwen3-8B judge's from 32 ms to 516 ms, making RubriX 7.7x faster than Jev and 18.8x faster than the Qwen3-8B judge at 3,000 tokens per level.
articles.titleCn: RubriX：一种快速、可微调的非自回归评分标准评估器
articles.abstractCn: 基于量规的评价要求判断响应符合量规的哪个级别。通常通过提示大型语言模型（LLM）作为评判者来完成，每次评判都需要生成式调用，并读取每个级别的描述，因此其成本随量规的增长而增加。我们提出了RubriX，一个受对比语言模型（CLM）启发的量规评判者：一个LoRA适配的编码器嵌入输入和每个级别的描述，通过对缩放余弦相似度进行softmax运算，为每个级别提供概率而不生成文本。在公开量规数据和专有合成数据上训练后，RubriX在保留的量规上达到75.4%的精确准确率，而TypeSafe的Jev为57.1%，Qwen3-8B评判者为49.8%。在八个人类标注的基准集上，RubriX在大多数集上与Jev的准确率相差在6个百分点以内，而Jev在两个集上保持更大优势，平均而言Jev排名最佳；与G-Eval论文中报告的结果相比，RubriX在所有SummEval维度和两个QAGS子集上均优于使用GPT-3.5的G-Eval。当级别嵌入被缓存时，随着级别描述从10个到3,000个token增长，RubriX的延迟保持在每次评判约28毫秒，而Jev（扣除近似网络时间）从44毫秒上升到211毫秒，Qwen3-8B评判者从32毫秒上升到516毫秒，使得在3,000个token每个级别的情况下，RubriX比Jev快7.7倍，比Qwen3-8B评判者快18.8倍。

articles.title: Adaptive Retrieval, Selective Answers: Evaluating Conformal Factuality in Agentic RAG
articles.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can improve factual grounding without guaranteeing that every generated claim is supported. Previous work has studied claim-level conformal factuality in single-stage RAG and, more recently, multi-hop RAG. We examine its behavior in agentic RAG, where a language-model policy adaptively issues follow-up retrieval queries or terminates retrieval before response generation. We retain the retrieval-based relevance-scoring formulation and post-generation conformal filtering and evaluate six model-dataset configurations: GPT-6 Luna and Llama 3.1 8B on HotpotQA, Natural Questions, and TriviaQA. Each configuration uses 60 fixed questions, 100 seeded 30/30 calibration-test partitions, five conformal target levels, and a no-conformal-prediction baseline. Across the six configurations, higher target levels are accompanied by higher observed full-support rates and reduced answer availability. At the 95% target, non-empty response coverage ranges from 17.23% to 60.17%, claim retention from 10.72% to 43.16%, and full support among non-empty outputs from 89.14% to 95.56%. We formulate the adaptive retrieval trajectory explicitly and characterize the reliability-informativeness trade-off when conformal factuality is applied after agent termination.
articles.titleCn: 自适应检索，选择性答案：评估代理式RAG中的符合性事实性
articles.abstractCn: 检索增强生成（RAG）可以在不保证每个生成声明都得到支持的情况下提升事实基础性。先前研究已探讨单阶段RAG中的声明级符合性事实性，以及较新的多跳RAG。我们考察了其在代理式RAG中的表现，其中语言模型策略会自适应地发出后续检索查询或在生成回复前终止检索。我们保留了基于检索的相关性评分公式，并在生成后进行符合性过滤，评估了六种模型-数据集配置：GPT-6 Luna和Llama 3.1 8B在HotpotQA、Natural Questions和TriviaQA上的表现。每种配置使用60个固定问题、100个种子30/30校准测试分区、五个符合性目标级别，以及无符合性预测的基线。在六种配置中，更高的目标级别伴随着更高的观察全支持率和降低的答案可用性。在95%的目标下，非空响应覆盖率介于17.23%至60.17%，声明保留率介于10.72%至43.16%，非空输出中的全支持率介于89.14%至95.56%。我们明确地构建了自适应检索轨迹，并在代理终止后应用符合性事实性时，刻画了可靠性与信息量之间的权衡。

articles.title: DocTalk: Enhancing Medical Knowledge Retrieval via Fine-tuned Large Language Models with Chain-of-Thought Reasoning for Robust Clinical Decision Support
articles.abstract: Objective: The rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs) in healthcare has opened new possibilities for AI-assisted clinical decision-making; however, safe and effective deployment remains challenging because of hallucination and domain misalignment. This study introduces DocTalk, a doctor-assistive question-answering (QA) system designed to generate concise, chart-grounded responses from de-identified discharge summaries. Methods: We developed a high-fidelity data generation pipeline that produces 500 clinically relevant QA pairs through sentence-level decomposition, chain-of-thought-guided question formulation, and expert review. Six open-source LLMs, including three general-purpose and three biomedical models, were evaluated before and after parameter-efficient instruction tuning using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA). The framework integrates prompt engineering, in-context learning, and medically aligned evaluation to support factual and interpretable responses. Results: On DocTalk-QA, instruction tuning produced consistent improvements across lexical, semantic, and clinical fidelity metrics. The best-performing tuned model, Llama-3-Med42-8B, achieved ROUGE-L = 0.40, BERTScore-F1 = 0.76, and UMLS-F1 = 0.49. To examine external generalization beyond the DocTalk-QA dataset, the two best-performing models, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Llama-3-Med42-8B, were evaluated on PubMedQA before and after instruction tuning. Accuracy improved from 0.931 to 0.977 for Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and from 0.935 to 0.943 for Llama-3-Med42-8B. Conclusion: DocTalk was deployed as a secure web-based platform for interactive EHR querying. These findings suggest that clinically grounded instruction tuning can improve medical QA performance and support practical clinical decision support.
articles.titleCn: DocTalk：基于思维链推理微调的大型语言模型增强医学知识检索，以实现稳健的临床决策支持
articles.abstractCn: 目标：大型语言模型（LLM）在医疗领域的快速发展为AI辅助临床决策开辟了新的可能性；然而，由于幻觉和领域错位，安全有效的部署仍然具有挑战性。本研究介绍了DocTalk，一个为医生设计的问答（QA）辅助系统，该系统从去识别化的出院记录中生成简洁、基于图表的响应。方法：我们开发了一个高保真数据生成管道，通过句子级分解、思维链引导的问题构建和专家审查，产生了500对临床相关的QA对。在低秩适配（LoRA）参数高效指令微调之前和之后，评估了六个开源LLM，包括三个通用模型和三个生物医学模型。该框架集成了提示工程、情境学习和医学对齐评估，以支持事实性和可解释的响应。结果：在DocTalk-QA上，指令微调在词汇、语义和临床保真度指标上均表现出一致的改进。表现最佳的微调模型Llama-3-Med42-8B，达到了ROUGE-L = 0.40、BERTScore-F1 = 0.76和UMLS-F1 = 0.49。为了检验超出DocTalk-QA数据集的外部泛化能力，对表现最佳的两种模型Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct和Llama-3-Med42-8B在PubMedQA上进行指令微调前后的评估。Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct的准确率从0.931提高到0.977，Llama-3-Med42-8B从0.935提高到0.943。结论：DocTalk被部署为一个安全的基于网络的平台，用于交互式电子健康记录（EHR）查询。这些发现表明，基于临床的指令微调可以提升医学QA性能，并支持实际的临床决策支持。

articles.title: Priority-Preserving Advantage Aggregation for Multi-Reward Policy Optimization
articles.abstract: LLM post-training often optimizes multiple objectives with unequal priorities, such as correctness and reasoning efficiency. However, the widely used additive reward aggregation in RL can violate these priorities: when primary and auxiliary advantages conflict, a sufficiently large auxiliary signal can overturn the preference induced by the primary objective. We term this problem \emph{advantage priority inversion}. Although reward-level gating can protect priority more directly, it still removes potentially useful auxiliary distinctions among rollout samples that fail the primary condition. To address this trade-off, we propose Primary Advantage Policy Optimization (\textbf{PAPO}), a priority-aware advantage aggregation method that asymmetrically combines a primary and an auxiliary advantage. PAPO retains auxiliary supervision when the objectives agree and smoothly attenuates conflicting auxiliary signals, preserving the primary sign during fusion for \emph{primary-consistent ordering}. This rule applies to sequence-level advantages in GRPO and token-level advantages in actor--critic PPO. Experiments on multiple domains and models show that PAPO consistently achieves the best primary objective while maintaining best or competitive auxiliary-objective performance across both GRPO- and PPO-based optimization. \href{https://xiangchi-yuan.github.io/papo-project/}{Code is available}.
articles.titleCn: 多奖励策略优化的优先级保留优势聚合
articles.abstractCn: LLM的微调过程通常需要优化多个具有不同优先级的指标，例如准确性和推理效率。然而，强化学习中广泛使用的加性奖励聚合可能会破坏这些优先级：当主要指标和辅助指标的收益冲突时，一个足够大的辅助信号可能会推翻主要目标诱导的偏好。我们将此问题称为\emph{收益优先级反转}。尽管奖励级门控可以更直接地保护优先级，但它仍然会移除那些未能满足主要条件的滚动样本中潜在的、有用的辅助区分。为了解决这种权衡，我们提出了主要收益策略优化（\textbf{PAPO}），这是一种优先级感知的收益聚合方法，它不对称地结合了主要收益和辅助收益。PAPO在目标一致时会保留辅助监督，并平滑地衰减冲突的辅助信号，在融合过程中保留主要符号以实现\emph{主要一致性排序}。该规则适用于GRPO中的序列级收益和actor--critic PPO中的标记级收益。在多个领域和模型上的实验表明，PAPO始终在主要目标上达到最佳性能，同时在基于GRPO和PPO的优化中保持最佳或具有竞争力的辅助目标性能。\href{https://xiangchi-yuan.github.io/papo-project/}{代码可用}。

articles.title: Semantic Atoms for Scalable Text Analysis in Data Analytics in the Era of LLM-Based Agents
articles.abstract: Much of the information needed for data analysis is buried in text columns: an analyst may infer customer frustration from complaint text and use it to explain resolution time. We call workloads in which processing text columns is central to subsequent data analysis TADA (\emph{Text Analysis in Data Analytics}). In an agentic setting, the user's query dynamically specifies this processing, and answering it interleaves LLM-based semantic steps with exact SQL or Python operations. This mixed execution raises two design questions: which work should be neural and which symbolic, and which semantic outputs later steps can reuse. We address them for agent-planned TADA workflows with two complementary, query-driven semantic atoms. Each atom takes a sequence of text items and a natural-language query specifying the semantic task: \textbf{Tagging} returns one string per input item, while \textbf{Categorization} returns $M$ category objects over $N$ input items. Tagging results are materialized as a row-aligned column and Categorization results as a category table; SQL or Python then performs exact computation over this exposed state. We realize this interface in TADA-Agent, whose atoms run inside generated Python programs and internally handle inputs beyond a reliable context window. We evaluate TADA-Agent on TABench, a benchmark of 40 complete analysis requests over spreadsheet tables spanning workflow composition, input--output structure, and literature-grounded analytical scenarios. Against a semantic-operator baseline and relative to a held-out TADA reference run, TADA-Agent delivers comparable row-level semantic quality, has higher complete-artifact preservation estimates, and uses over an order of magnitude fewer semantic-model requests under the evaluated native execution paths.
articles.titleCn: 基于LLM智能体的数据分析时代中可扩展文本分析语义原子
articles.abstractCn: 数据分析所需的大部分信息都隐藏在文本列中：分析师可能从投诉文本中推断出客户的不满情绪，并以此解释解决时间。我们将那些处理文本列是后续数据分析核心的工作负载称为TADA（数据分析中的文本分析）。在自主环境中，用户的查询动态指定这种处理，而回答该查询则交错进行基于LLM的语义步骤与精确的SQL或Python操作。这种混合执行提出了两个设计问题：哪些工作应该由神经网络处理，哪些应该由符号系统处理，以及后续步骤可以重用哪些语义输出。我们针对由代理规划的TADA工作流，通过两个互补的、查询驱动的语义原子来解决这些问题。每个原子都接受一系列文本项和一个指定语义任务的自然语言查询：\textbf{标记}为每个输入项返回一个字符串，而\textbf{分类}则对N个输入项返回M个类别对象。标记结果以行对齐的列形式呈现，分类结果以类别表形式呈现；SQL或Python随后对这些暴露的状态进行精确计算。我们在TADA-Agent中实现了这种接口，其原子在生成的Python程序中运行，并内部处理超出可靠上下文窗口的输入。我们在TABench上评估了TADA-Agent，这是一个涵盖工作流组合、输入-输出结构以及基于文献的分析场景的40个完整分析请求的基准测试。与语义算子基线和与保留的TADA参考运行相比，TADA-Agent提供了相当的行级语义质量，具有更高的完整工件保留估计，并在评估的原生执行路径下使用了超过一个数量级的更少语义模型请求。

articles.title: Position Matters More Than Channel: Talking a Language Model Out of a Correct Answer
articles.abstract: Language models now answer questions alongside other claims: a note in the system prompt, a message from another agent, their own earlier answer. We ask what it takes to talk a model out of an answer it gets right on its own, and separate three factors that earlier studies vary together: where the advice sits in the prompt, who is said to have written it, and what the model has already written. On Qwen3.5-27B and four-option MMLU-Pro items, with the rest of the advice held fixed in each comparison, we find three things. First, position matters far more than the API channel, in opposite directions for a bare claim and an argument: a bare "the answer is X" does most harm just before the model answers, while the same claim with a false rationale does most harm before the question, where it raises error on items the model otherwise almost never misses from 1% to 67%; moving the claim between the system message and the user message at the same position changes error by a few points. Second, attributing the note to an authority rather than to another participant, and phrasing it assertively, each raise error by 10-27 points, while the two authorities we tested differ by under two. Third, replaying a correct worked answer before the advice protects it whether the text is shown as the model's own or as someone else's, and the same replay keeps wrong answers from being corrected by a bare correct note. The position result replicates under an independently written prompt. Code, items and all result tables are released at https://github.com/coolkillercat/safety.
articles.titleCn: 位置比渠道更重要：如何让语言模型给出正确答案
articles.abstractCn: 现在语言模型不仅回答问题，还会结合其他陈述：系统提示中的注释、来自其他代理的消息、模型自己之前的回答。我们探讨如何让模型放弃自己正确得出的答案，并从早期研究中将三个共同变化的因素区分开来：建议在提示中的位置、声称的作者以及模型已写的内容。在Qwen3.5-27B和四选项MMLU-Pro题目上，每次比较中保持其余建议固定，我们发现三点。首先，位置比API通道更重要，对于简单陈述和论证方向相反：一个简单的“答案是X”在模型回答之前造成最大伤害，而同样的陈述带有错误理由在问题之前造成最大伤害，它使模型在其他几乎从不出错的情况下错误率从1%上升到67%；将陈述在系统消息和用户消息中相同位置移动会改变错误率几个点。其次，将注释归因于权威而不是其他参与者，并使用断言语气，每项都会使错误率提高10-27点，而我们测试的两个权威差异不到两点。第三，在建议之前重播一个正确的答案可以保护它，无论文本显示为模型自己的还是他人的，同样的重播阻止错误答案被简单的正确注释纠正。位置结果在独立编写的提示下得到验证。代码、题目和所有结果表格已发布在https://github.com/coolkillercat/safety。

articles.title: Text Is the Bottleneck: A Small-Scale Replication of LLM Game Playing in Riichi Mahjong
articles.abstract: We replicate the riichi-mahjong track of "Can Large Language Models Master Complex Card Games?" (arXiv:2509.01328) under a drastically smaller budget: models of at most 2B parameters, one 16 GB consumer GPU, about five GPU-days. (1) With matched data and labels, text is the bottleneck: on the same 100k-decision training set, a 2.6M-parameter convolutional board encoder agrees with the strong AI Mortal on 80.6% of test decisions, above every text-prompt LLM we train (best 77.8%), and places better at the table (2.85 over 1,000 games vs. ~3.0 for the LLMs; paired difference at n=100 not significant). Scaled to 1.71M decisions, a 4.9M-parameter Transformer reaches 94.7% agreement, beats the 0.8B LLMs on identical seeds (-0.45 ranks, sign test p=0.005), and is statistically equivalent to parity against three Mortal champions (TOST within 0.10 ranks, p=6e-4); parity against a teacher-opponent is roughly the ceiling of pure imitation. (2) Training toward the teacher raises teacher agreement more than a 2.5x parameter increase does (+2.5 vs. +1.5 points); on human-record agreement both effects are +1.0, and neither is visible at the table. (3) Few-point agreement differences do not resolve into playing strength within a family: +2.5 agreement points coincide with a paired placement difference of +0.02 +/- 0.12 ranks (p=1.0), and +2.0 points at 2B with -0.06 (p=0.37) - both below the ~0.25-rank resolution of 100 paired games. We also document a paper-code mismatch in the original winner filter, reconstruct its two private engine patches, and show that a divide-and-conquer pipeline makes template-generated Japanese rationales 93% sentence-exact (43% without facts). Per Tenhou's terms we release no trained weights - only code, configurations, and evaluation protocols.
articles.comment: 12 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Replication of the riichi-mahjong track of arXiv:2509.01328. Code, configurations and ~3,200 arena game logs released; no trained weights (Tenhou data terms)
articles.titleCn: 文本是瓶颈：在日式麻将中关于大型语言模型游戏的小规模复制研究
articles.abstractCn: 我们在远低于预算的情况下复制了"Can Large Language Models Master Complex Card Games?"（arXiv:2509.01328）中的日麻轨迹：最多2B参数的模型，一个16GB消费级GPU，约五GPU天。(1) 在匹配数据和标签的情况下，文本是瓶颈：在相同的10万决策训练集上，一个260万参数的卷积棋盘编码器在测试决策上与强人工智能Mortal的同意度为80.6%，高于我们训练的所有文本提示LLM（最佳77.8%），并且在牌桌上表现更好（1000局游戏中2.85分超过1分，与LLM的~3.0分相比；配对差异在n=100时无显著性）。按1.71M决策缩放，一个490万参数的Transformer达到94.7%的同意度，在相同种子上击败了0.8B LLM（-0.45名次，符号检验p=0.005），并且与三位Mortal冠军在统计上相当（TOST在0.10名次内，p=6e-4）；与教师对手的平局大致是纯粹模仿的极限。(2) 朝向教师训练提高了教师同意度，比参数增加2.5倍的效果更好（+2.5分对比+1.5分）；在人类记录同意度上，两种效果都是+1.0分，且在牌桌上都看不到效果。(3) 几分点的同意度差异在一个家族内无法转化为战斗力：+2.5分同意度与配对名次差异+0.02 +/- 0.12名次（p=1.0）一致，以及2B参数下的+2.0分与-0.06（p=0.37）-两者都低于100配对游戏的~0.25名次分辨率。我们还记录了原始获胜过滤器中的论文-代码不匹配，重建了其两个私人引擎补丁，并证明了一个分而治之的流程使模板生成的日语理由达到93%的句子精确度（43%不含事实）。根据Tenhou的条款，我们不会发布训练后的权重——只发布代码、配置和评估协议。

articles.title: BehaviorMem: Building and Evaluating User Memory from Real-World E-Commerce Behavior Streams
articles.abstract: User memory helps personalized systems build on their understanding of users over time. In e-commerce, users convey their preferences and needs through both explicit language and implicit interactions with products. We study memory built from logs of these interactions, examining how it can \emph{remember} concrete evidence and established interests, and use that evidence to \emph{infer} underlying needs and preferences that inform judgments beyond well-observed product domains. Existing memory methods primarily target language-based interactions, and evaluations offer limited real behavioral data and limited separation of these capabilities. This leaves open how to jointly support and separately evaluate remembering and inference from behavioral logs. We formulate the problem of continual behavioral user memory around these joint requirements and develop a dedicated evaluation framework and memory method to address them. \textbf{BehaviorMemBench} is a benchmark built from real e-commerce logs covering 1{,}194 users and 17{,}462 behavioral batches over more than three years, with automatic future-behavior labels and a task-independent memory interface to separately evaluate remembering and inference under a common protocol. \textbf{BehaviorMem} is a memory design that organizes explicit behavioral facts and inferred user characteristics across long-term and short-term scopes in a two-axis state, with evidence-grounded formation, continual maintenance, and query-independent readout. Experiments across two builders and two task readers show that BehaviorMem leads the evaluated agentic memories on remember and infer, and reveal different method rankings across the two capabilities and competitive statistical baselines. Validation on a public dataset further supports its usefulness for downstream tasks based on behavioral histories.
articles.titleCn: 行为记忆：从真实世界电子商务行为流中构建与评估用户记忆
articles.abstractCn: 用户记忆帮助个性化系统随着时间的推移建立对用户的理解。在电子商务中，用户通过明确的语言和与产品的隐式互动来传达他们的偏好和需求。我们研究从这些互动日志中建立的记忆，考察它如何记住具体的证据和既定的兴趣，并利用这些证据来推断潜在的需求和偏好，这些需求和偏好指导着对观察到的产品领域之外判断的制定。现有的记忆方法主要针对基于语言的互动，评估提供了有限的实际行为数据和这些能力的有限分离。这留下了如何从行为日志中联合支持和单独评估记忆和推断的问题。我们围绕这些联合需求，提出了持续行为用户记忆的问题，并开发了一个专门的评价框架和记忆方法来解决这些问题。**BehaviorMemBench**是一个基于真实电子商务日志的基准，涵盖1194名用户和17462个行为批次，超过三年，具有自动的未来行为标签和任务无关的记忆接口，以在通用协议下单独评估记忆和推断。**BehaviorMem**是一种记忆设计，它在一个双轴状态中组织长期和短期范围内的明确行为事实和推断的用户特征，具有基于证据的形成、持续维护和查询无关的读取。跨越两个构建者和两个任务读取者的实验表明，BehaviorMem在记忆和推断方面领先于评估的代理记忆，并揭示了这两种能力中不同方法的排名和具有竞争力的统计基线。在公共数据集上的验证进一步支持了它对基于行为历史的下游任务的实用性。

articles.title: Natural Jammers: When Non-Robust Features Become Antagonistic
articles.abstract: Deep neural networks are known to rely on non-robust features that align poorly with human perception. Prior work has largely framed these features as opportunistic shortcuts that help standard models on clean data. We show instead that non-robust cues can be antagonistic: they can act as Natural Jammers that actively mislead standard models on clean, unmodified images. Using disagreement between a standard model and robust models as an analysis lens, we identify a Jammed Set on which robust models outperform standard models. We provide causal evidence for Spectral-spatial Locking: jamming arises only when high-frequency components are precisely aligned with specific spatial structures. Disrupting this lock through spectral filtering or small geometric shifts can restore correct predictions. Crucially, we uncover a Substitution Paradox: while individual jammers are fragile to geometric shifts, the aggregate prevalence of jamming remains approximately stable and is redistributed rather than eliminated under such transformations. Our results reframe natural non-robustness as a failure field over the empirical model-data geometry: one that redistributes rather than disappears under small transformations.
articles.titleCn: 自然干扰器：当非鲁棒特征变得对抗性
articles.abstractCn: 深度神经网络已知依赖于与人类感知不符的非鲁棒特征。以往研究主要将这些特征视为有助于标准模型在干净数据上的机会性捷径。我们则表明，非鲁棒线索可能具有对抗性：它们可以作为自然干扰因素，在干净、未经修改的图像上主动误导标准模型。通过将标准模型与鲁棒模型之间的分歧作为分析视角，我们识别出一个被干扰的集合，在该集合上鲁棒模型的表现优于标准模型。我们为频谱-空间锁定提供了因果证据：干扰仅在当高频分量与特定空间结构精确对齐时才会发生。通过频谱滤波或微小几何变换破坏这种锁定，可以恢复正确的预测。关键地，我们揭示了一种替代悖论：虽然单个干扰因素对几何变换很脆弱，但在这种变换下，干扰的总体普遍性保持近似稳定，并重新分配而非消除。我们的结果表明，自然非鲁棒性可以被视为在经验模型-数据几何上的失效领域：在小变换下，它重新分配而非消失。

articles.title: DynEdit: Dynamic Entropy-Guided Sequential Editing for Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Knowledge editing aims to update outdated or incorrect knowledge in large language models without full retraining. Existing parameter-editing methods remain limited for long-sequence knowledge: single-point editors provide insufficient coverage for extended targets, while fixed chunk-based editors distribute editing effort uniformly across rigid predefined windows, failing to prioritize difficult, information-dense tokens. In this work, we show that token entropy is closely associated with both editing difficulty and semantic importance: high-entropy regions are harder to edit and often contain key factual content. Motivated by this observation, we propose DynEdit, a dynamic framework for long-sequence knowledge editing. DynEdit uses token-level entropy to guide non-uniform sliding, increasing the coverage of difficult high-entropy regions, and further applies entropy-guided token-level optimization to strengthen updates on information-dense tokens within each editing window. Experiments on three benchmarks and two backbone models show that DynEdit consistently outperforms competitive baselines across diverse long-form editing settings, achieving gains of up to +14.0 BLEU points on challenging paraphrase queries and near-saturated semantic scores on several diverse knowledge domains.
articles.comment: Accepted by main conference of NeurIPS 2026 (poster)
articles.titleCn: DynEdit：面向大型语言模型的动态熵引导序列编辑
articles.abstractCn: 知识编辑旨在在不进行完整再训练的情况下更新大型语言模型中的过时或错误知识。现有的参数编辑方法在处理长序列知识时仍存在局限：单点编辑器对扩展目标覆盖不足，而固定块编辑器在预定义的刚性窗口中均匀分配编辑工作，未能优先处理困难且信息密集的标记。在本工作中，我们证明标记熵与编辑难度和语义重要性密切相关：高熵区域更难编辑，且通常包含关键事实内容。基于这一观察，我们提出了DynEdit，一种用于长序列知识编辑的动态框架。DynEdit利用标记级熵指导非均匀滑动，增加对困难高熵区域的覆盖范围，并进一步应用熵引导的标记级优化，以加强每个编辑窗口内信息密集标记的更新。在三个基准测试和两个骨干模型上的实验表明，DynEdit在各种长格式编辑场景中始终优于有竞争力的基线，在具有挑战性的释义查询上取得了高达+14.0 BLEU分的提升，并在多个不同知识领域实现了接近饱和的语义分数。

articles.title: From Belief Inference to Task Action: A Multi-Level Evaluation of Theory of Mind on Verifiable Tasks
articles.abstract: Effective collaboration requires language models to understand what others know and believe, and to act accordingly. Models that assume others share their information may omit necessary communication and undermine coordination. Many theory-of-mind (ToM) benchmarks assess mental-state inference through story questions, but correct answers do not establish that models can use these judgments in subsequent tasks. We introduce a multi-level evaluation built on existing, verifiable tasks. We extend household collaboration and calendar scheduling with asymmetric information while retaining their original constraints and validators. Independent interfaces assess world understanding, information access, beliefs, decisions, and execution. Controls supply personal evidence or correct beliefs to distinguish state recovery from state use. Across six model configurations, these abilities diverge. On matched scheduling cases, Claude recovers all agent beliefs correctly but produces subjectively optimal plans in only 67.9% of cases. In household collaboration, supplying beliefs raises Qwen-27B success from 55.0% to 75.0%, yet Qwen-4B answers every fixed supplied-belief source question correctly while completing only 20.0% of the corresponding continuation condition. These results show why ToM evaluation must connect perspective inference to independently verified decisions and task consequences.
articles.titleCn: 从信念推理到任务行动：对心智理论在可验证任务上的多层级评估
articles.abstractCn: 有效的协作需要语言模型理解他人的知识和信念，并据此采取行动。假设他人共享信息的模型可能会遗漏必要的沟通，从而破坏协调。许多心智理论（ToM）基准通过故事问题来评估心理状态推理能力，但正确的答案并不能证明模型能在后续任务中使用这些判断。我们引入了一个基于现有、可验证任务的多层次评估体系。我们扩展了家庭协作和日程安排任务，引入了不对称信息，同时保留了它们原有的约束和验证器。独立的接口评估世界理解、信息获取、信念、决策和执行能力。控制组提供个人证据或正确信念，以区分状态恢复与状态使用。在六种模型配置中，这些能力表现出差异。在匹配的日程安排案例中，Claude正确恢复了所有代理人的信念，但在67.9%的情况下产生了主观最优计划。在家庭协作中，提供信念将Qwen-27B的成功率从55.0%提高到75.0%，但Qwen-4B正确回答了所有固定提供信念来源的问题，却在相应的延续条件下仅完成了20.0%。这些结果表明，心智理论评估必须将视角推理与独立验证的决策和任务后果联系起来。

articles.title: Mechanistic Insights into LoRA: Layer Sparsity for Adaptive Fine-Tuning via Path Patching
articles.abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has emerged as the dominant paradigm for parameter-efficient fine-tuning of large language models. Standard all-layer LoRA applies adaptation throughout the transformer, despite heterogeneous contributions from its components. In this work, we conduct a systematic mechanistic interpretability analysis to understand how LoRA affects model internals. We observe that LoRA's adaptation effect is highly non-uniform, with significant component-wise and layer-wise sparsity. Most critically, we find that important layers are highly task-dependent, with limited overlap across tasks. Motivated by these insights, we propose Adaptive-LoRA, a calibration-driven method that automatically identifies task-specific layers via frozen-base zero-ablation, enabling efficient layer selection without exhaustive search. Extensive experiments on Qwen2.5-1.5B across 11 diverse reasoning tasks demonstrate that Adaptive-LoRA outperforms full-layer LoRA while using only 30% of layers, achieving a $3.5\times$ reduction in adapter parameters. This work bridges mechanistic interpretability and practical efficiency, providing both fundamental insights and a principled approach for adaptive fine-tuning.

articles.titleCn: 对LoRA的机理洞察：通过路径修补实现自适应微调的层稀疏性
articles.abstractCn: 低秩适配（LoRA）已成为大语言模型参数高效微调的主流范式。标准全层LoRA在整个Transformer中进行适配，尽管其组件贡献存在异质性。在本工作中，我们进行了一项系统的机制可解释性分析，以理解LoRA如何影响模型内部机制。我们观察到LoRA的适配效果高度不均匀，存在显著的组件级和层级级稀疏性。最重要的是，我们发现重要层级高度依赖于任务，不同任务间的重叠性有限。基于这些见解，我们提出了自适应LoRA（Adaptive-LoRA），这是一种以校准驱动的自适应微调方法，通过冻结基础模型零消融（zero-ablation）自动识别特定任务的层级，从而实现无需穷举搜索的高效层级选择。在Qwen2.5-1.5B模型上进行的11项多样化推理任务的大量实验表明，自适应LoRA在仅使用30%层的情况下，优于全层LoRA，适配参数减少了3.5倍。这项工作连接了机制可解释性与实际效率，既提供了基础性见解，也为自适应微调提供了一种原则性方法。

articles.title: DecisionTraceBench: Tracking Decision-Critical Information in Multi-Party Spoken Conversations
articles.abstract: In high-stakes domains such as finance, critical information evolves through multi-party interaction. Recovering these changes and their sources is fundamental to reliable speech understanding. Existing speech benchmarks focus on transcription, local understanding, and turn-level state prediction, leaving joint decision evolution across speakers insufficiently evaluated. We introduce DecisionTraceBench, a speech state-tracking benchmark for Decision-Critical Information State Tracking (DCIST). It jointly evaluates decision event sequences, speaker attribution, scope, and temporal evidence, using trajectory-level F1 to measure complete event-chain recovery. Our dataset comprises Chinese financial dialogues involving two to four speakers, with 100.39 hours of synthetic audio and 8.61 hours of human-performed recordings. On a fixed cohort of human-performed recordings, five cascaded systems and two direct-audio models achieve DCIST scores of 5.73% to 21.35%. Ablations with speaker-labeled reference scripts and no temporal localization requirements yield a maximum score of only 38.72%. Audio perturbation experiments further show that overall transcription error rates do not adequately reflect complete trajectory recovery. These findings reveal limitations in jointly understanding information provenance and state evolution, providing a benchmark for evaluating decision-process understanding and decision traceability in high-stakes speech applications.
articles.titleCn: 决策追踪基准：追踪多方语音对话中的决策关键信息
articles.abstractCn: 在金融等高风险领域中，关键信息通过多方交互演变。恢复这些变化及其来源对于可靠的语音理解至关重要。现有的语音基准主要关注转录、局部理解和回合级状态预测，而跨说话人的联合决策演变评估不足。我们引入了DecisionTraceBench，这是一个用于决策关键信息状态追踪（DCIST）的语音状态追踪基准。它联合评估决策事件序列、说话人归属、范围和时间证据，使用轨迹级F1来衡量完整事件链的恢复。我们的数据集包含涉及两到四个说话人的中文金融对话，包括100.39小时的合成音频和8.61小时的人工录制音频。在固定的人工录制音频集上，五个级联系统和两个直接音频模型实现了5.73%至21.35%的DCIST分数。使用说话人标记的参考脚本且无时间定位要求的消融实验，最高分数仅为38.72%。音频扰动实验进一步表明，整体转录错误率并不能充分反映完整轨迹的恢复。这些发现揭示了联合理解信息来源和状态演变方面的局限性，为评估高风险语音应用中的决策过程理解和决策可追溯性提供了基准。

articles.title: LADDER: Diagnosing Domain-Level Self-Assessment Under Noisy Feedback
articles.abstract: Knowing when they are reliable is essential for language models to support human-AI collaboration. Yet interaction feedback is not always complete or correct, and may mislead models' understanding of their own capabilities. We introduce LADDER to study how language models assess themselves under unreliable feedback. Our findings show that models can accurately report supplied performance information while still struggling to form trustworthy self-assessments from interaction experience. Apparently accurate assessments can obscure capability differences and do not necessarily predict future task performance. These findings suggest that trustworthy self-assessment should be evaluated against observed task performance and its predictive value. Our study provides empirical evidence of the limits of model self-knowledge and a basis for evaluating capability awareness in reliable human-AI collaboration.
articles.titleCn: 梯子：在噪声反馈下进行领域级自我评估的诊断
articles.abstractCn: 了解语言模型何时可靠对于支持人机协作至关重要。然而，交互反馈并不总是完整或准确，可能会误导模型对自己能力的理解。我们引入LADDER来研究语言模型在不可靠反馈下如何自我评估。我们的研究发现，模型能够准确报告提供的性能信息，但在从交互经验中形成值得信赖的自我评估方面仍存在困难。显然准确的自评可能会掩盖能力差异，并不一定预测未来的任务表现。这些发现表明，值得信赖的自我评估应通过与观察到的任务表现及其预测价值进行评估。我们的研究提供了模型自我认知局限性的实证证据，并为在可靠的人机协作中评估能力意识奠定了基础。

articles.title: iPrefBench: A User-Centric Benchmark for Personalized Mobile Use Agents
articles.abstract: An agent that truly knows and acts on behalf of its user has been a long-standing promise of AI assistants. Computer-use agents bring this promise within reach by capably executing fully specified tasks across apps. However, real-world user requests are often underspecified. To act correctly for the particular user, an agent must infer some missing information from the user's activity history and ask for other information that only the user can provide, without making unsupported assumptions or burdening the user with unnecessary questions. We present iPrefBench, a benchmark for evaluating the infer and ask capabilities of personal mobile-use agents in an executable iOS environment with an interactive simulated user. Grounded in a coherent persona with 3,051 past activity events, iPrefBench comprises 130 underspecified user tasks across 26 apps. Each omitted user-dependent requirement is, by construction, either history-inferable or ask-only. iPrefBench evaluates personalized mobile agents on both whether agents complete tasks correctly for the user (i.e., personalized task completion) and whether they seek user input when necessary (i.e., user-agent interaction). Evaluation of 7 frontier agents reveals a substantial gap between execution and personalization. Agents achieve high action completion scores (up to 91.6%) but low full task success (up to 47.7%) because personalization lags behind. They especially struggle with ask-only information, failing to request enough necessary information. Our findings highlight a challenge for personalized agents in knowing what to infer and when to ask. We hope that iPrefBench can serve as a valuable testbed for building agents that know their user and work with them.
articles.titleCn: iPrefBench：一个以用户为中心的个性化移动使用代理基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 一个真正了解用户并代表用户行动的智能体一直是AI助手的长期承诺。电脑使用智能体通过在应用程序中出色地执行完全指定的任务，将这一承诺变为现实。然而，现实中的用户请求通常不够明确。为了针对特定用户正确行动，智能体必须从用户的活动历史中推断某些缺失信息，并请求只有用户才能提供的信息，同时不做出未经证实的假设或不让用户回答不必要的问题。我们提出了iPrefBench，这是一个用于在具有交互式模拟用户的可执行iOS环境中评估个人移动使用智能体推断和询问能力的基准。基于一个具有3,051个过去活动事件的连贯角色，iPrefBench包含26个应用程序中的130个不够明确用户任务。每个遗漏的用户相关要求，根据设计，要么是可从历史中推断的，要么是只能通过询问获取的。iPrefBench评估个性化移动智能体在两个方面：智能体是否正确完成针对用户的任务（即个性化任务完成）以及是否在必要时寻求用户输入（即用户-智能体交互）。对7个前沿智能体的评估揭示出执行与个性化之间存在巨大差距。智能体实现了高行动完成分数（高达91.6%），但全任务成功率低（高达47.7%），因为个性化滞后。它们尤其难以处理只能通过询问获取的信息，未能请求足够必要的信息。我们的研究突出了个性化智能体在知道该推断什么以及何时询问方面的挑战。我们希望iPrefBench能成为构建了解用户并与用户合作的智能体的有价值测试平台。

articles.title: Knowing When the Evidence Is Enough: Requirement-Directed Search with Horn-Closure Certificates
articles.abstract: After each Web search, a search-augmented model must decide whether its evidence suffices: answer, search again, or abstain. Prevailing systems leave this to holistic model judgement, which can accept a context naming every entity yet lacking one required fact. We instead make sufficiency structural: a per-query requirement hypergraph states which facts jointly yield another fact. This raises two challenges: deriving requirements from the question alone, and linking each requirement to passages about the right entity. Certify therefore decomposes the question, searches per requirement, and accepts links only after entity checks. Horn closure over the links yields a certificate, the minimal sufficient passages and their derivation, or an abstention naming open requirements. Given correct retrieval, requirements and links, the decision is sound, and complete up to the entity check. Pooled over three corpora with unanswerable twins, Certify decides significantly more accurately than search agents, graph retrieval and sufficiency judges in default configurations. On the same evidence, it matches a proprietary model's sufficiency label without an additional model call. Over 21M Wikipedia passages, entity checks add 4 to 13 points of decision accuracy where gold evidence exists. Finally, answers from its certificate are 80% correct, against 57% from all retrieved passages.
articles.titleCn: 知道何时证据足够：面向需求的搜索与Horn闭包证书
articles.abstractCn: 在每次网络搜索之后，搜索增强型模型必须判断其证据是否充分：回答、再次搜索或放弃。现有系统将此决策权交给整体模型判断，这种判断可能接受一个命名每个实体的上下文，但缺乏所需的事实。我们则将充分性结构化：为每个查询构建一个要求超图，该超图声明哪些事实共同推导出另一个事实。这带来了两个挑战：仅从问题中推导出要求，以及将每个要求链接到关于正确实体的段落。因此，Certify将问题分解，按要求进行搜索，并在实体检查后仅接受链接。链接上的Horn闭包产生一个证书，即最小充分的段落及其推导过程，或一个命名开放要求的放弃。在正确的检索、要求和链接下，该决策是可靠的，并且在实体检查之前是完整的。在包含无解双胞胎的三个语料库上，Certify在默认配置下比搜索代理、图检索和充分性判断器决策准确度显著更高。在相同证据下，它无需额外的模型调用即可匹配专有模型的充分性标签。在超过2100万篇维基百科段落中，当存在金标准证据时，实体检查将决策准确度提高了4到13个百分点。最后，其证书产生的答案正确率为80%，而所有检索到的段落正确率仅为57%。

articles.title: Agent Memory as Recommendation: Recommender-System Design for Long-Term Memory of LLM Agents
articles.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents that serve users across many sessions must choose, for every request, the few stored memories that enter a limited context window. This choice largely decides whether the agent answers correctly, and it runs on every request at Web scale. This selection faces three challenges: a large and growing store, a per-request cost budget, and multi-session questions that need all of their evidence. Many memory systems build notes or graphs with hundreds to thousands of LLM calls per history, and each is designed on its own, so it is unclear which component yields the accuracy. These challenges mirror the properties of recommendation, so we formalize agent memory as budgeted slate recommendation, with the request as the user, stored memories as items and the context window as a slate. The formalization places memory systems in one design space of recommender cascades and factorizes accuracy into the completeness that each stage controls. Guided by it, we propose AgentMemRec, which adapts candidate generation, learning to rank and slate construction from recommender systems and selects memories without any LLM call. On multi-session questions of LongMemEval, AgentMemRec outperforms memory and context-selection methods, including A-Mem, HippoRAG 2, DynamicRAG and T-Mem, by 10 to 31 points of accuracy. It matches an LLM reranker that makes 64 calls per query at 3.2 times lower serving cost, and on LoCoMo it outperforms Mem0 and Zep without any LLM call at write time. The factorization attributes the gains to slates that more often hold all of the evidence, so recommender-system design offers an effective and efficient foundation for the long-term memory of LLM agents.
articles.titleCn: 基于代理记忆的推荐：面向长时记忆的大型语言模型代理的推荐系统设计
articles.abstractCn: 为用户跨多个会话服务的大型语言模型（LLM）代理必须为每个请求选择少量存储的记忆进入有限的上下文窗口。这一选择在很大程度上决定了代理是否能正确回答，并且需要在Web规模上对每个请求运行。这一选择面临三个挑战：庞大的且不断增长的存储库、每个请求的成本预算限制，以及需要所有证据的多会话问题。许多记忆系统通过为每个历史记录构建包含数百到数千次LLM调用的笔记或图，并且每个系统都是独立设计的，因此不清楚哪个组件决定了准确性。这些挑战反映了推荐的特性，因此我们将代理记忆形式化为预算限制的候选集推荐，其中请求作为用户、存储的记忆作为物品、上下文窗口作为候选集。这种形式化将记忆系统置于推荐级联设计空间中，并将准确性分解为每个阶段控制的完整性。基于此，我们提出了AgentMemRec，该系统借鉴了推荐系统中的候选集生成、学习排序和候选集构建方法，并在没有任何LLM调用的情况下选择记忆。在LongMemEval的多会话问题中，AgentMemRec在准确性上比记忆和上下文选择方法（包括A-Mem、HippoRAG 2、DynamicRAG和T-Mem）高出10到31个百分点。它匹配了一个每次查询进行64次调用的LLM重排序器，但服务成本降低了3.2倍，并且在LoCoMo上，它在写入时无需任何LLM调用的情况下优于Mem0和Zep。这种分解将收益归因于候选集更频繁地包含所有证据，因此推荐系统设计为LLM代理的长期记忆提供了一个有效且高效的坚实基础。

articles.title: AdaTutor: Adaptive Tutoring through Pedagogical Strategy Selection
articles.abstract: Effective tutoring requires determining not only what information to provide, but also which form of assistance to deliver. A tutor may address the same student error using various pedagogical strategies, adapting its approach as the interaction progresses. We introduce Comparative Pedagogical Supervision (CPS), a training framework to learn to select the optimal strategy and feedback for student learning. We evaluate CPS on math and science reasoning datasets. After five tutoring turns, CPS outperforms the strongest fixed-strategy baselines. The learned tutor transfers across datasets, and its strategy selection can also inform a separate API-based tutor.
articles.titleCn: AdaTutor：通过教学策略选择实现自适应辅导
articles.abstractCn: 有效的辅导不仅需要确定提供哪些信息，还需要选择合适的辅助形式。辅导者可以使用多种教学策略来处理同一个学生的错误，并根据互动的进展调整其方法。我们介绍了比较教学监督（CPS），这是一个用于学习选择最佳策略和反馈以促进学生学习效果的培训框架。我们在数学和科学推理数据集上评估了CPS。经过五轮辅导后，CPS的表现优于最强的固定策略基线。学习到的辅导者可以跨数据集迁移，其策略选择也可以为基于API的独立辅导者提供参考。

articles.title: Heard Enough to Act: Early Tool Calling in Spoken Dialogue Systems
articles.abstract: Latency-sensitive spoken agents must know not only which tool to call, but also when they have heard enough to act. Waiting for the turn to complete delays execution even when the request is already actionable. However, neither existing spoken agents nor spoken dialogue corpora define the earliest point at which a request becomes actionable. We introduce a synthetic spoken-dialogue pipeline that provides earliest-actionable-point supervision, marking when the observed speech grounds a tool and its required arguments. Through controlled task generation, speech synthesis and alignment, and gated annotation, we construct 26,694 dialogues totaling 786 hours across 48 domains, with disjoint training and test argument values. We additionally create an audio rendering of $τ^2$-bench for external evaluation. We train an omni-modal language model on this corpus, enabling causal, chunk-level decisions and partial-transcript generation for downstream call completion. The model achieves tool-state macro-F1 scores of 0.48 and 0.47 on held-out dialogues and the external benchmark, respectively. For correct calls, the estimated mean lead over a turn-end cascade, using the same formatter, is 1.8-2.0 seconds in-domain and 1.1 seconds on $τ^2$-bench. These results demonstrate a data-driven path toward spoken agents that act while listening. We will open-source the pipeline and the training scripts.
articles.titleCn: 听到足够的行动：口语对话系统中的早期工具调用
articles.abstractCn: 对延迟敏感的语音代理不仅需要知道调用哪个工具，还需要知道何时已听到足够信息来采取行动。即使请求已经可执行，等待回合完成也会延迟执行。然而，现有的语音代理和语音对话语料库都没有定义请求最早可执行的时间点。我们引入了一个合成语音对话流程，提供最早可执行点监督，标记观察到的语音何时能触发工具及其所需参数。通过受控的任务生成、语音合成与对齐，以及门控标注，我们构建了包含48个领域的26,694个对话，总时长786小时，且训练和测试参数值不重叠。此外，我们还创建了$τ^2$-bench的音频渲染版本用于外部评估。我们在该语料库上训练了一个全模态语言模型，实现因果的块级决策和部分转录生成，以支持下游的调用完成。该模型在保留的对话和外部基准上的工具状态宏观F1得分分别为0.48和0.47。对于正确的调用，使用相同的格式器，模型在领域内估计的平均领先时间（相对于回合结束级联）为1.8-2.0秒，在$τ^2$-bench上为1.1秒。这些结果展示了数据驱动路径下，语音代理在听取时即行动的可行方案。我们将开源该流程和训练脚本。
